We’re unapologetically ambitious. Some might call us bold, others might call us extra—but that’s exactly how we like it. Self-development, transparency, discipline, and a relentless pursuit of excellence? That’s what fuels us 24/7. And now, we’re looking for a Marketing Manager who shares our appetite for impact.

❕This role is 100% remote and you will join a team that already works from 20 different world countries.

THE ROLE

We're seeking a dynamic and results-driven Marketing Manager to join our growing e-commerce team. This role is perfect for a full-stack marketer who thrives on owning projects from conception to execution. You'll be the driving force behind our marketing initiatives, ensuring seamless collaboration with design and development teams to deliver high performing landing pages and funnels, and drive significant sales growth.

Unlike a traditional performance marketing role, this position emphasizes strategic marketing management, customer research, and the ability to bridge the gap between marketing vision and execution. You’ll be responsible for ensuring high-quality output across all marketing touchpoints, from landing pages and ad creatives to customer journeys.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Strategic Marketing Management:

    • Develop and execute comprehensive marketing strategies aligned with business goals.

    • Conduct thorough market and customer research to identify opportunities and optimize campaigns.

    • Analyze marketing performance data to provide actionable insights and recommendations.

    • Manage and prioritize marketing projects, ensuring timely delivery and high-quality results.

    • Ideate new ways to increase scale in our funnels and campaigns.

  • Creative & Content Oversight:

    • Write compelling marketing copy for ads, landing pages, and other marketing materials.

    • Review and provide constructive feedback on design assets, ensuring they meet brand standards and conversion goals.

    • Oversee the design and optimization of ad creatives, by managing design resources.

  • Landing Page & Website Optimization:

    • Conduct thorough QA of landing pages and website elements to ensure optimal user experience and functionality.

    • Implement and monitor A/B tests to improve conversion rates.

    • Collaborate with development teams to implement website updates and enhancements.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration:

    • Act as a liaison between marketing, design, and development teams, ensuring clear communication and alignment.

    • Provide clear and concise briefs to design and development teams, ensuring projects are delivered to specification.

    • Manage and track project progress, providing regular updates to stakeholders.

  • Customer Research and Analysis:

    • Gather and analyse customer feedback, and data to inform marketing strategies.

    • Identify customer pain points and opportunities for improvement.

    • Optimise towards scaling sales, and execute on new ideas to increase customer acquisition.

Requirements

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Proven experience in a marketing management or full-stack marketing role within an e-commerce environment.

  • Strong understanding of digital marketing principles and best practices.

  • Excellent copywriting and communication skills.

  • Experience with CRO and website optimization.

  • Ability to analyze data and provide actionable insights against what sells.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills.

  • Experience working with design and development teams.

  • Ability to work remotely and manage your own time effectively.

  • A strong understanding of customer research and how to implement it.

  • A passion for e-commerce and a desire to drive growth.

  • Strong performance marketing experience.

    Bonus Points:

  • Experience with specific marketing automation tools.

  • Familiarity with heatmaps, ads managers, and analytics tools.

THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS

  • 10 min online DISC assessment to identify your behavioral style, as we strongly believe in the power of diverse teams.

  • 15-30 min e-meet with the Foxelli Group Talent Acquisition Partner.

  • Home Task.

  • 60 min e-meet with the Hiring Manager and Foxelli Group CPO to discuss the vision of the role, your competencies, and technical skills, followed by a two-way Q&A session.

  • Decision & Feedback from us.

SALARY

€1,500 - €2500 after taxes (depending on yourskills, competencies, and experience) with the potential for quarterly performance-based bonuses tied to KPIs.

❕Please note that this role requires a self-employment certificate.

PERKS & BENEFITS

Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers. Avec plus de 20 000 clients et 1 million d’utilisateurs dans 98 pays, nos solutions N2F et Keeple s’imposent comme des références sur le marché français.

N2F est une solution complète de gestion des dépenses professionnelles (notes de frais, cartes corporate, factures fournisseurs), et Keeple centralise la gestion RH du quotidien (congés, absences, temps de travail) le tout dans une interface simple, intuitive et 100% connectée (app web et mobile).

Portés par une équipe engagée, qui place l’humain au centre de ses priorités, nous poursuivons une ambition claire : devenir le leader européen de la gestion des dépenses professionnelles.

Dans ce contexte, nous recherchons un(e) Développeur(se) spécialisé(e) en Intelligence Artificielle pour renforcer notre équipe R&D et accélérer le développement de nos solutions innovantes. Tu travailleras sur la conception, l’intégration et l’industrialisation de cas d’usage IA (LLM, Machine Learning, RAG, automatisation) au service de nos produits SaaS.

Missions principales :

  • Conception et développement de solutions IA en Python.

  • Mise en place de pipelines RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pour améliorer la pertinence des modèles,

  • Exploitation du cloud AWS et en particulier des services IA/LLM (ex. Bedrock),

  • Intégration d’outils IA et d’orchestration (N8N, OpenAI, Claude, …),

  • Expérimentation et amélioration continue via prompt engineering et fine-tuning de modèles,

  • Veille technologique sur les innovations IA et proposition d’idées/concepts pour enrichir nos produits,

  • Collaboration avec les équipes produit, data et dev pour industrialiser des solutions IA fiables et scalables.

Compétences techniques attendues :

  • Maîtrise du langage Python.

  • Expérience sur AWS (idéalement Bedrock, Lambda, S3, etc.),

  • Bonne culture des APIs IA (OpenAI, Claude, etc.).

C’est un plus si :

  • Première expérience en mise en production de solutions IA/LLM

  • Connaissances avancées en LLM et techniques de prompting,

  • Pratique du RAG et des architectures de recherche de données contextuelles,

  • Familiarité avec des outils d’orchestration et d’automatisation (ex. N8N),

Requirements

Soft skills :

  • Force de proposition : capable de transformer la veille technologique en solutions concrètes,

  • Autonomie et rigueur dans le développement,

  • Goût pour le travail collaboratif (produit, QA, data, dev),

  • Curiosité et capacité à vulgariser l’IA pour des profils non techniques.

Profil recherché :

  • Expérience confirmée (3 à 5 ans minimum) en développement logiciel (si possible sur des projets IA)

  • Expérience dans un contexte cloud (idéalement AWS),

Ce que ce poste n’est PAS :

  • de la data science (pas de modélisation statistique, pas d’entraînement de modèles maison),

  • un rôle de recherche LLM ou NLP,

  • un poste MLOps centré sur l’infrastructure ou la gestion de clusters,

  • un rôle orienté expérimentation académique.

Ce poste est bel et bien un rôle de développeur(se) logiciel : il s’agit de concevoir, intégrer et industrialiser des fonctionnalités IA directement dans nos produits SaaS. Tech, pragmatique, orienté production.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Un environnement stimulant et innovant,

  • Des défis techniques stimulants à fort impact technologique dans une culture de la qualité et du partage,

  • Une vraie autonomie dans les choix techniques, et du temps pour faire bien,

Les avantages chez N2JSOFT :

  • Chèques cadeaux à Noël,

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Medical Billing & Coding Specialist with strong hands-on experience supporting U.S. healthcare practices.

The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of direct experience in U.S. healthcare billing and coding, preferably working within an actual medical practice or healthcare organization such as Primary Care, Behavioral Health, Mental Health, Dental, Ophthalmology, or another specialty practice.

This is a hands-on role for a professional who understands the U.S. healthcare revenue cycle and can independently manage billing, coding, claims, denials, Accounts Receivable (AR), and payer-related processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle day-to-day U.S. medical billing and coding activities.
  • Prepare, review, and submit accurate claims to Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance payers.
  • Review medical records and billing information to ensure accurate coding and claims submission.
  • Apply and interpret CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, and appropriate modifiers.
  • Identify and correct billing and coding errors that may result in claim rejections or denials.
  • Manage denials, rejected claims, appeals, and claim corrections.
  • Perform Accounts Receivable (AR) follow-up and resolve outstanding insurance balances.
  • Investigate unpaid, underpaid, and denied claims and follow up with insurance companies.
  • Support the complete Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) process.
  • Review EOBs and ERAs and reconcile payments against submitted claims.
  • Perform payment posting and identify discrepancies where applicable.
  • Verify and maintain accurate patient and insurance information.
  • Work with payer portals, clearinghouses, EHR/EMR systems, and billing platforms.
  • Identify recurring billing and denial issues and recommend improvements.
  • Maintain accurate records and documentation.
  • Communicate professionally with insurance companies, healthcare providers, patients, and internal teams when required.
  • Follow client-specific billing, coding, compliance, and workflow requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on U.S. medical billing and coding experience.
  • Direct experience working within a U.S. healthcare practice, clinic, or healthcare organization.
  • Experience supporting one or more healthcare specialties, such as: Primary Care / Family Medicine, Behavioral Health, Mental Health, Dental, Ophthalmology, Specialty Care, & Other U.S. healthcare practice environments
  • Strong understanding of the U.S. healthcare Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) process.
  • Hands-on experience with: Medical Billing, Medical Coding, Claims Submission, Denial Management, Accounts Receivable (AR), Claim Follow-up, Payment Posting, Insurance Verification and/or Eligibility
  • Experience working with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance.
  • Strong understanding of CPT codes, with working knowledge of ICD-10, HCPCS, and modifiers.
  • Ability to review claims and identify billing or coding discrepancies.
  • Strong understanding of insurance payer processes and requirements.
  • Strong computer skills and ability to work with healthcare software, EHRs/EMRs, clearinghouses, and payer portals.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working directly within a specific U.S. healthcare practice or specialty.
  • Experience handling complex denials, appeals, and aging AR.
  • Experience with multiple insurance payer portals and clearinghouses.
  • Experience with healthcare EHR/EMR and practice management systems.
  • Medical billing or coding certification such as CPC, CCS, CPB, CCA, or equivalent.

Certification is not required, but a relevant medical billing or coding certification is considered a plus.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a senior-level, hands-on professional, not someone whose experience is limited to general healthcare administration.

The ideal candidate should be able to demonstrate practical experience managing the U.S. medical billing and coding process, including CPT coding, claims submission, payer follow-up, denials, AR, and RCM.

Candidates with direct experience working inside a medical practice or healthcare organization are strongly preferred.

Application Requirements

When applying, please ensure your CV clearly highlights:

  1. Your 3+ years of U.S. medical billing and coding experience.
  2. The specific healthcare practice(s) or specialties you have supported.
  3. Your experience with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance.
  4. Your hands-on experience with CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, and modifiers.
  5. Your experience with RCM, denials, AR, claims, and payment posting.
  6. The EHR/EMR, billing systems, clearinghouses, and payer portals you have used.
  7. Any relevant medical billing or coding certifications.

Please note: Candidates whose experience is primarily general healthcare administration, without hands-on U.S. medical billing and coding experience, may not be considered.

Joint Use Specialist

Position Overview

The Joint Use Specialist is responsible for coordinating and managing the joint use process related to electric utility infrastructure. This role supports power and broadband infrastructure projects by working closely with electric utilities, municipalities, engineering teams, and contractors to ensure proper pole attachment approvals, compliance with utility standards, and efficient project execution. The Joint Use Specialist will oversee pole attachment applications, track make-ready activities, and ensure all work aligns with utility and regulatory requirements. Depending on skillset, specialists may assist with electric distribution designs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the joint use process for projects involving electric utility poles and power infrastructure.
  • Prepare, submit, and track pole attachment applications with electric utilities and pole owners.
  • Coordinate with internal engineering teams and external utility representatives to review pole loading and attachment requirements.
  • Monitor application progress, approvals, and make-ready timelines to keep projects on schedule.
  • Maintain detailed records of pole attachment applications, approvals, and construction activities.
  • Identify potential conflicts related to pole capacity, clearances, or utility standards and assist in resolving issues.
  • Support project managers by providing updates on joint use status and regulatory requirements.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, including utility safety and clearance standards.

Qualifications

  • Knowledge of electric distribution systems and utility pole attachment standards.
  • Familiarity with joint use agreements, make-ready processes, and utility coordination procedures.
  • Strong organizational and project tracking skills.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills when working with utilities and engineering teams.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and project management tools.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience working with electric cooperatives, investor-owned utilities, or municipal utilities.
  • Experience designing electric distribution facilities for a utility company.
  • Familiarity with pole loading analysis and clearance requirements such as NESC (National Electrical Safety Code).
  • Experience supporting fiber deployment projects attached to power utility infrastructure.
  • Knowledge of utility permitting and regulatory processes.

Work Environment

This role may be performed remotely or in a hybrid setting depending on project needs. Occasional travel may be required for coordination meetings with utilities, field verification, or project site visits.

Compensation and Benefits

This position offers competitive pay and an attractive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance, 401(k), and more.

About Vantage Point Solutions

Vantage Point Solutions was founded in 2002 by a team who believed in putting people — both employees and clients — first. VPS is a customer-focused, technology-driven engineering and consulting firm serving the broadband, power, and financial industries.

Our team is driven by a commitment to client satisfaction. We foster a culture of teamwork, respect, and commitment — with a healthy mix of camaraderie and fun.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Vantage Point Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

About the Position

Meridian University is currently hiring multiple adjunct faculty to teach graduate courses in Clinical Psychology.

These roles are fully remote -- applications across the US and internationally are welcome.

Master's and Doctoral degrees in Psychology at Meridian provide a cumulative, emergent, and integrated curriculum, empowering the student’s transformation both personally and professionally.

The Psychology program integrates a number of diverse orientations including Integral Psychology, Somatic and Yoga Psychology, Depth Psychology, Transpersonal Psychology, and Clinical Psychology. Learning outcomes include collaborativity, law and ethics, process skills, psychopathology, reflexivity, empathy, and culture.

Psychology at Meridian integrates three distinct dimensions of Psychology: academic discipline, vocation and profession. Psychology at Meridian seeks to reclaim the soul through the imagination, and draws on numerous knowledge domains which are not a recognized part of the conventional discipline and profession of psychology.

About Meridian

Founded 30 years ago in the San Francisco Bay Area, Meridian University enrolls students globally in its unique hybrid and 100% online graduate degree, certificate, and public programs. The University offers master's and doctoral programs in Psychology, Education and Business with diverse concentrations available within each of these programs. Meridian’s integrated, innovative curriculum is designed to be experiential and transformative.

Meridian graduates are engaged in varied professional contexts that include coaching, psychotherapy, organizational development, facilitation, social healing, social entrepreneurship, and transformative leadership.

Meridian’s graduate programs are available in two formats, hybrid and 100% online. This model supports students who are working professionals and balancing other life commitments to move forward towards their personal and professional future.

Meridian is accredited by the WASC Senior College and University Commission and approved by the US Department of Education for participation in the Federal Student Aid program. WASC is the Department of Education-recognized regional accreditor for such schools as the University of California at Berkeley, UCLA, and Stanford University. Meridian’s licensable degrees have been recognized by the California Board of Behavioral Sciences and Board of Psychology for over 25 years.

Qualifications

  • PsyD or PhD in Psychology from an accredited institution
  • Prior teaching experience
  • Experience with online teaching in Blackboard, Canvas, D2L, or Moodle
  • Experienced with a variety of cloud-based platforms like Microsoft Office 365
  • Consistently inspired to achieve and grow your contribution
  • Committed to life-long learning and personal responsibility
  • Excited by team collaboration and complex challenges
  • Live courses at Meridian are scheduled between the hours of 8am and 12pm PT. Availability within these hours is necessary for faculty to receive course assignments.

How to Apply

A cover letter and resume are required. In your cover letter, speak to your alignment with Meridian’s vision and mission as well as your skills and capacities relevant to the role description and qualifications.

Each application is reviewed thoroughly by multiple teams and faculty are hired on an as-needed basis. Therefore, timelines for applicant review, interviewing, and course assignment are unpredictable. We cannot respond to all applications due to the volume received.

Please do not call, email, or drop-in regarding your application.

Meridian is committed to diversity across all criteria-of-difference in its staff, faculty, and students. Meridian does not consider race, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status in hiring or admissions decisions.

We are seeking an experienced Bilingual Dental Billing & Accounts Receivable Specialist (English & Spanish) to support a dental practice with end-to-end dental billing, claims management, and accounts receivable activities.

  • Use Weave for practice communications as required.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on dental billing, insurance, or accounts receivable experience.
  • Previous experience working directly with a dental office, dental practice, or dental healthcare organization.
  • Hands-on experience with Dentrix Ascend is required.
  • Strong understanding of dental claims and the dental insurance billing process.
  • Experience with claim submission, payment posting, EOB/ERA review, denials, and AR follow-up.
  • Strong understanding of dental insurance terminology, procedures, and billing workflows.

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to identify billing discrepancies.

Preferred Experience

Candidates with experience in the following areas are especially encouraged to apply:

  • Dental insurance billing
  • Dental claims and denial management
  • Dental AR and aging reports
  • Insurance follow-up
  • EOB/ERA reconciliation
  • Patient billing and collections
  • Dentrix Ascend
  • Weave
  • Dental practice management

Work Schedule

Both part-time and full-time candidates will be considered. The final schedule will be determined based on the candidate's availability and the client's operational needs.

About the Role

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Executive Partner / Project Coordinator to work in close partnership with the CEO, Creative Director, and Chief of Staff. This role sits at the intersection of executive support, project coordination, and creative operations, with a strong focus on communication flow, follow-through, and execution.

You will act as a force multiplier for leadership by reducing distractions, anticipating needs, and ensuring priorities, commitments, and initiatives move forward smoothly across teams and stakeholders.

What You’ll Do

Administrative and Executive Support

  • Provide high-level administrative support, including calendar management, travel coordination, inbox triage, scheduling, and other ad hoc support tasks as needed.
  • Support the CEO’s headspace by reducing distractions and handling tactical execution, including both business and limited personal administrative tasks to maintain executive focus and momentum.

Executive Communication Management

  • Own the executive communication flow by filtering, prioritizing, and routing information so the Chief of Staff and CEO can focus on decision making.
  • Ensure the CEO is not missing important communications across channels.
  • Ensure communications are handled in a timely and respectful manner, including responding on behalf of the CEO when appropriate.
  • Reply on behalf of the CEO, as the CEO, in scenarios required to coordinate meetings and keep conversations moving forward.

Project Coordination and Follow Up

  • Support the Chief of Staff in execution by coordinating project timelines, follow ups, and deliverables across teams to ensure consistent progress.
  • Own project coordination tasks, including status tracking, meeting logistics, and stakeholder follow ups, to enable the Chief of Staff to focus on strategy and decision making.
  • Partner with the Chief of Staff to manage and maintain project documentation, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Track deadlines, commitments, and dependencies tied to CEO owned initiatives.
  • Own and actively manage the CEO’s task list, ensuring all action items are clearly captured, prioritized, and aligned to realistic timelines.
  • Maintain clear visibility into task progress, following through to ensure completion and preventing items from slipping, while enabling the CEO to stay focused on the highest impact work.

Meetings and Action Management

  • Support meeting preparation by coordinating logistics, tracking action items, and following up on deliverables.
  • Ensure meeting notes and action items are precisely understood and that ownership is clearly delegated or taken on directly by the Executive Partner when required.
  • Proactively manage the CEO’s calendar and meetings, ensuring thoughtful scheduling across time zones, especially during travel, while avoiding overbooking and allowing sufficient time for preparation and follow-ups.

Stakeholder and Relationship Coordination

  • Manage day to day coordination across stakeholders to ensure commitments are met.
  • Coordinate external relationships from an execution and logistics standpoint.

Research, Strategy, and Brand Support

  • Conduct research and prepare briefs on topics, partners, or opportunities the CEO needs to evaluate, while also ensuring that these are prepared and read ahead of time.

About You

  • 8+ years of experience providing executive support to senior leadership or C-level executives.
  • Proven track record of project coordination and cross-functional execution.
  • Experience working in startups or fast-paced, ambiguous environments, with the ability to thrive amid changing priorities.
  • Exceptional organizational, follow-up, and prioritization skills in a fast-paced, remote environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to represent the CEO when appropriate.
  • Comfortable operating across creative, production, and operational functions.
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and solution-oriented, with the ability to anticipate needs before they arise.
  • Familiarity with content production workflows is a strong plus.
  • Strong research skills, both for professional and personal projects.

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • Close, trusted partnership with executive leadership.
  • High level of ownership and autonomy with clear expectations.
  • Exposure to high-impact creative, strategic, and operational initiatives.
  • Opportunity to grow into broader responsibility and leadership over time.
  • A dynamic role that blends executive support, project coordination, and creative operations.

raw.description:
BioDigital is searching for a Strategic Account Director to manage and expand enterprise accounts, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure clients fully utilize their cloud-based, interactive 3D human body visualization platform and realize its value in enhancing health education and understanding. This role requires a strong background in SaaS and/or healthcare sales, excellent communication and collaboration skills, and a passion for making healthcare accessible to everyone.

Who we are

BioDigital has built the first cloud-based solution for visualizing the human body in interactive 3D. Like Google Earth for the human body, our cutting-edge technology empowers patients, educators, and professionals worldwide with an engaging, visual way to learn about health and medicine. Our team is on a mission to make health and the human body understandable to all, and we’re seeking a talented, customer-centric Strategic Account Director to help execute on our ambitious goals.

Who you are

Ideally, you'll have a proven track record in selling and managing cloud-based software solutions, particularly within healthcare, life sciences, or medical technology. You are skillful and passionate about developing and managing high-value, complex client relationships by deeply understanding their needs, proactively identifying opportunities to expand business within the account, and collaborating cross-functionally to deliver strategic solutions that align with the client's long-term goals. You enjoy collaboration with sales, product, content, and customer success teams to help clients realize the value of our platform. You are detail oriented, a creative problem solver, and have a personal connection to our mission of helping people better understand their health.

What you’ll do

  • Own and manage a book of our largest enterprise accounts with revenue growth, renewal and retention targets.
  • Identify and qualify new expansion opportunities within existing accounts, proactively presenting value propositions and driving incremental revenue growth ensuring a healthy pipeline for consistent revenue growth.
  • Manage account renewals and proactively identify opportunities to introduce additional products and services that align with customer objectives, driving increased value.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans, identifying potential growth areas, key decision-makers, and strategic initiatives, focusing on upsell and product adoption (perhaps add something like: maximize revenue and customer value).
  • Proactively identify and understand evolving customer needs, challenges, and pain points, while building strong, trusted relationships with key stakeholders. Use this insight to develop tailored solutions that address their specific objectives and help achieve their business goals.
  • Own the overall success of the account by leading cross-functional collaboration, bringing in specialists (e.g., Account Executive, Integration Engineer, Product Manager, Science Lead, and Training/Onboarding team) as needed. Work closely with internal teams to ensure seamless execution and timely delivery of solutions.
  • Monitor customer satisfaction and track key account metrics, address concerns promptly, and ensure successful implementation and ongoing usage of solutions to maintain strong client relationships.
  • Provide accurate forecasting and account updates in CRM, maintaining detailed records of client interactions, sales stages, and follow-up activities. Provide insights to inform strategic decision-making.
  • Build value-based relationships with key executive level decision makers by leveraging existing client relationships and building new ones.
  • Represent BioDigital at industry events or trade shows.

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 5-10 years experience in a key account director, strategic account director or enterprise sales role.
  • Proven track record of achieving revenue targets and managing complex, high-value accounts within a B2B environment.
  • Strategic thinker with demonstrated ability to create account management plans and build trusted relationships throughout strategic accounts.
  • Strong analytical skills and data-driven decision-making capabilities.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and senior leadership to achieve shared goals. Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to understand customer needs and tailor solutions accordingly.
  • Inquisitive by nature and interested in uncovering issues to identify business opportunities.
  • Detail oriented and committed to high quality deliverables.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship building skills at the executive level.
  • Creative problem-solving attitude.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead teams to achieve goals without positional authority.
  • Experience working with B2B SaaS products and/or medical device or life sciences companies preferred.
  • Ability to travel up to 25% of the time for internal meetings, client meetings, trade shows and events
The hiring range for this position is $130,000- $140,000 base per year with the opportunity for variable compensation based on successful renewals and upsells. The actual offer may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors.

Equal Opportunity Workplace

BioDigital is committed to equal employment opportunity and to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All hiring decisions are based on business need, job requirements and individual qualifications, regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, parental status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

Our client is a renowned supplier of IT services to government institutions, multinational corporations, public administrations and multinational companies, research and academic institutes.

Our client currently has a vacancy for a Scrum Master to offer his/her services as an expert remotely within the EU. In the context of the first assignment, the successful candidate will be integrated in the team of the company that will closely cooperate with a major client’s IT team on site.

Job Type: B2B Contract

Workplace: Remote

Requirements

  • University Degree and at least 8 years of IT professional experience;
  • Minimum of 3 of dedicated experience working as a Scrum Master at SM2 level or above;
  • Led at least 2 production teams through full sprint cycles (planning, review, retrospective, and refinement);
  • Implemented data-driven continuous improvement initiatives, such as increasing team velocity or reducing lead time;
  • Experience coordinating cross-team work via Scrum-of-Scrums or PI Planning events;
  • Deep knowledge of the Scrum Guide and Agile Manifesto principles and values;
  • Good knowledge of facilitation techniques (e.g., Fist of Five, participatory decision-making, Liberating Structures);
  • Good knowledge of systems-thinking and process tailoring to fit complex or evolving environments;
  • Good knowledge of team motivation and stakeholder engagement techniques (e.g., information radiators, team empowerment models);
  • Good knowledge of Agile metrics (velocity, cycle time, burn-up/down charts, cumulative flow diagrams) and the ability to build and interpret dashboards to support team performance and forecasting;
  • Tool proficiency in Azure DevOps (preferred) or Jira, particularly in backlog management, dashboards, and workflow configuration;
  • Possession of Scrum Master certifications: PSM II (or higher) and SAFe 5/6 Agilist;
  • Experience with one or more scaled Agile frameworks (SAFe, Nexus, LeSS, etc.) is considered as an asset;
  • Knowledge of integrating SAFe and Kanban approaches to optimize flow and delivery predictability is considered as an asset;
  • Excellent command of the English language.

Responsibilities

  • Organize and facilitate agile activities and ceremonies including daily stand-up meetings, sprint reviews, retrospectives, sprint and release planning, and product backlog refinement sessions;
  • Ensure that all meetings are positive, productive, stay on topic, and are kept within the timebox;
  • Collaborate closely with the product owner to manage the backlog;
  • Coach team and Product Owner on empiricism, value‑based backlog slicing, and incremental delivery;
  • Track and radiate flow metrics (velocity, sprint burndown, iteration burn rate) and guide the team in data‑driven improvement;
  • Champion and facilitate adoption of agile standards, tools, and best practices;
  • Proactively identify and resolve impediments to team progress;
  • Promote empowered, self‑organising teams, shared vision, psychological safety, collaborative decisions (e.g., Fist‑of‑Five);
  • Uphold Definition of Done, quality gates, and compliance with organisational standards;
  • Communicate with other SCRUM masters and product owners across the organization to ensure transparency into delivery progress, challenges, and risks;
  • Utilize team feedback and metrics (e.g., quality, delivery, cadence, etc.) to identify areas of opportunity and work with team to continuously improve;
  • Support the team in using agile planning and development tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Confluence);
  • Experiment with new practices and frameworks to improve team outcomes;
  • Actively participate in learning opportunities such as communities of practice or conferences to improve skills and better support the team;
  • Contribute to the advancement and improvement of agile practices within the organization.

Job Title: Senior Service Program Director

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

The Senior Service Program Director is responsible for leading the overall success of strategic customer service partnerships by driving customer satisfaction, operational performance, program governance, retention, profitable growth, and long-term partnership value. This role serves as the senior customer-facing leader and strategic point of accountability for assigned enterprise healthcare systems, ensuring GE HealthCare delivers on service commitments, operational expectations, contractual obligations, and business outcomes.

The Senior Director provides business and program management leadership across the GE HealthCare–customer service partnership, developing strategies that support customer satisfaction, retention, growth, and operational excellence. This role works in close alignment with Executive Client Director, regional service teams, functional centers of excellence, commercial partners, finance, field service, supply chain, engineering, and executive leadership to ensure a coordinated, enterprise-wide approach to customer success.

This role also includes direct people leadership responsibility for 5+ direct reports, which may include Service Program Managers, Enterprise Program Managers, Asset Management Leaders, and other customer operations or program leadership roles. The Senior Director is accountable for building team capability, setting clear expectations, coaching performance, aligning work to business priorities, and ensuring consistent execution across the customer operations organization.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Customer Partnership & Executive Engagement

  • Serve as the senior strategic customer interface for assigned enterprise service partnerships.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with executive, operational, clinical, technical, and administrative customer stakeholders.
  • Establish trusted partnership with customer leadership to understand priorities, business objectives, pain points, and opportunities for value creation.
  • Lead executive governance discussions, strategic business reviews, and senior-level customer engagement routines.
  • Represent GE HealthCare in strategic, operational, contractual, and business discussions with the customer.
  • Protect and strengthen the customer relationship by ensuring issues are addressed proactively, transparently, and with clear ownership.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partnership value, strengthen retention, and protect against competitive threats.

2. Service Partnership Governance & Operational Leadership

  • Lead the overall governance model for assigned customer partnerships, ensuring clear operating mechanisms, escalation paths, communication routines, and decision-making processes are in place.
  • Implement robust reporting and review processes to track service performance, program progress, KPIs, customer commitments, operational risks, financial performance, and project status.
  • Ensure internal and external governance routines are effective, action-oriented, and aligned to customer and GE HealthCare objectives.
  • Facilitate alignment across account teams, regional service teams, field service, functional centers of excellence, and commercial partners.
  • Drive operational discipline across customer programs to ensure commitments, deliverables, and improvement actions are completed on time.
  • Lead regular program, technical, operational, and executive reviews with customers and internal leadership.

3. People Leadership & Team Development

  • Directly lead, coach, and develop a team of 5+ direct reports, including roles such as SPM, EPM, AML, and other customer operations/program leadership positions.
  • Set clear performance expectations, priorities, operating rhythms, and accountability standards for direct reports.
  • Coach team members on customer engagement, communication, escalation management, project execution, executive readiness, and operational ownership.
  • Build leadership capability across the team by developing talent, identifying skill gaps, supporting career growth, and creating development plans.
  • Establish consistent team standards for customer communication, business reviews, contract governance, escalation management, reporting, and follow-through.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, team operating reviews, performance check-ins, and development conversations.
  • Create a high-accountability, customer-centric culture focused on ownership, proactive communication, operational excellence, and measurable outcomes.
  • Ensure team members are aligned to customer priorities, GE HealthCare strategy, regional objectives, and service delivery commitments.

4. Customer Satisfaction, Retention & Growth

  • Own strategic programs that improve customer satisfaction, customer experience, and long-term retention.
  • Develop and execute customer success strategies that support service partnership health, contract renewal, expansion opportunities, and customer loyalty.
  • Partner with commercial and account teams to identify growth opportunities, renewal risks, service expansion needs, and broader GE HealthCare portfolio solutions.
  • Use customer feedback, performance data, and Voice of Customer insights to drive continuous improvement and strengthen partnership value.
  • Proactively identify risks to customer satisfaction and lead mitigation plans across internal teams.
  • Ensure customer priorities are translated into measurable actions, owners, timelines, and outcomes.

5. Contract, Financial & Business Performance Leadership

  • Provide leadership oversight for service partnership performance against contractual, operational, financial, and customer commitments.
  • Ensure appropriate contract documents, acceptance certificates, variation agreements, governance documentation, and customer-facing commitments are completed accurately and on time.
  • Partner with finance, commercial, service, and operations teams to monitor profitability, cost performance, operational risk, billing issues, and contract health.
  • Establish operational mechanisms to manage long-term program liabilities, customer obligations, quality expectations, safety requirements, and profitability objectives.
  • Support contract renewal strategies, expansion discussions, financial reviews, and customer business planning.
  • Drive accountability for accurate reporting, issue resolution, milestone tracking, and financial performance visibility.

6. Escalation Leadership & Enterprise Problem Resolution

  • Lead senior-level customer escalations and high-visibility service events requiring cross-functional alignment and executive awareness.
  • Act as the customer advocate within GE HealthCare while balancing customer needs, contractual obligations, operational realities, and business objectives.
  • Ensure escalations have clear ownership, timeline, communication plan, root-cause review, and corrective action path.
  • Coordinate across field service, supply chain, engineering, technical support, commercial, finance, and leadership teams to resolve complex issues.
  • Communicate transparently with customer and internal stakeholders during critical events.
  • Drive sustainable corrective actions to prevent repeat issues and improve service delivery.

7. Program Management, Project Execution & Operational Excellence

  • Lead enterprise-level programs, initiatives, and workstreams that support service partnership success.
  • Track programmatic and project progress against agreed plans, customer commitments, KPI targets, operational risks, cost expectations, and performance objectives.
  • Drive operational excellence initiatives that improve efficiency, customer experience, profitability, service delivery, and internal accountability.
  • Collaborate with customers and internal teams to develop and communicate best practices across the enterprise.
  • Ensure program updates, dashboards, action logs, and leadership reports are accurate, timely, and outcome-focused.
  • Hold internal stakeholders accountable for execution of customer commitments and continuous improvement actions.

8. Cross-Functional Leadership & Enterprise Alignment

  • Lead through influence across a matrixed organization to align resources, remove barriers, and ensure customer commitments are achieved.
  • Partner closely with Account Executives, Service Leadership, Field Service, Finance, Commercial, Supply Chain, Engineering, Legal, Quality, and Centers of Excellence.
  • Ensure communication is clear and consistent across customer teams, internal leadership, direct reports, and support functions.
  • Represent customer needs and operational risks in internal leadership discussions.
  • Build alignment across GE HealthCare teams to deliver a unified customer experience.

9. Compliance, Quality & Risk Management

  • Ensure customer programs operate in alignment with GE HealthCare policies, quality requirements, contractual obligations, governance expectations, and safety standards.
  • Monitor operational risk, service performance risk, project risk, customer satisfaction risk, and financial risk across assigned partnerships.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation, reporting, contract records, customer commitments, and governance materials are maintained.
  • Support audits, operational reviews, compliance activities, and customer governance requirements as needed.

Desired Attributes

The successful Senior Director demonstrates:

  • Executive presence and strong customer-facing leadership
  • Ability to build trust with senior customer stakeholders
  • Strong people leadership, coaching, and team development capability
  • High accountability and ownership mindset
  • Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed environment
  • Strong business acumen, including financial, operational, and contractual awareness
  • Customer-centric decision making
  • Strategic thinking balanced with operational execution
  • Strong communication and executive-level presentation skills
  • Ability to synthesize complex issues and communicate clear actions
  • Strong program management and governance discipline
  • Ability to drive retention, growth, and partnership value
  • Confidence leading escalations and complex problem resolution
  • Continuous improvement mindset
  • Ability to build scalable processes and consistent operating rhythms

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Healthcare Administration, Engineering, Operations, or related field.
  • 8+ years of healthcare project/program management, service leadership, customer operations, or related experience.
  • 5+ years of direct team leadership experience.
  • Experience leading teams of 5+ direct reports, including customer-facing, operational, program management, or service leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead customer relationships, service partnerships, program governance, and cross-functional execution.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex issues and communicate clearly to executive, customer, and internal audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to energize, develop, coach, and build rapport with teams and stakeholders at all levels of an organization.
  • Strong operational, financial, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to lead through influence in a matrixed organization.
  • Willingness to travel as required to support customer engagement, team leadership, and partnership governance.

Preferred

  • Experience leading strategic healthcare service partnerships or enterprise customer operations.
  • GE HealthCare Diagnostic Imaging, Clinical Services, or healthcare technology service experience.
  • Experience working directly with hospital administration, executive customer leadership, or enterprise healthcare systems.
  • Experience in service delivery, account management, consulting, project management, process improvement, or Lean/Six Sigma environments.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare service lines, operational planning, P&L management, balance sheets, capital planning, and contract performance.
  • Experience leading teams that include Service Program Managers, Enterprise Program Managers, Asset Management Leaders, or similar customer operations roles.
  • Experience supporting customer retention, contract renewals, growth initiatives, and strategic governance models.

Measures of Success

Success in this role is measured by:

  • Customer satisfaction and executive relationship strength
  • Customer retention and renewal performance
  • Growth opportunity identification and partnership expansion support
  • Contract performance and profitability
  • Service delivery performance against agreed KPIs
  • Operational governance effectiveness
  • Escalation resolution effectiveness
  • Program execution and milestone achievement
  • Team performance, engagement, retention, and development
  • Direct report performance against role expectations and customer commitments
  • Quality and consistency of business reviews, customer communication, and leadership reporting
  • Cross-functional alignment and execution discipline
  • Risk identification and mitigation effectiveness
  • Continuous improvement impact
  • Compliance with contractual, operational, safety, and quality requirements

About Us

Tameson is a global e-commerce store helping small and medium businesses source industrial components online. We are looking for a Head of Technical Content to take end-to-end ownership of our technical presence.

About the Role

This is not a standard copywriting role or strategist role. We want someone with an engineering mind and a marketing insight, someone who figures things out, builds things, and ships them without waiting to be told. Someone who understands who our customers are: engineers and procurement teams at small and medium businesses sourcing industrial components, and what they need to make a confident purchase decision. If you are excited about building AI-driven content pipelines, that matters more than a long track record.

You will own technical content from strategy to publication, including its technical accuracy. Your output shapes how engineers find Tameson, how the site ranks, and whether visitors convert into buyers. You work closely with our Product and Operations teams to extract technical knowledge and turn it into content competitors cannot replicate.

A Flavor of What You’d Work On

  • Audit our solenoid valve categories, identify what is missing or underperforming, and decide whether the fix is a selection guide, a page restructure, JSON-LD, or additional supporting content. Build it and analyze performance.

  • Take our internal valve performance test data and turn it into a content series: articles, comparison tables, video scripts, email campaigns, social posts. Build assets from proprietary data that competitors cannot replicate.

  • Work with industry partners to reach their communities through forums, sponsored placements, or native articles on their platforms.

  • Analyze pages that get traffic but do not convert. Investigate whether it is a traffic quality, content quality, or conversion issue, implement a fix, and track the result against sales.

  • Get up to speed on a product you know little about, write a buyer guide, fact-check it against manufacturer datasheets, and publish it without a technical reviewer.

Key Outcomes & Responsibilities

  • End-to-End Ownership: You will identify gaps in our content, style, and approach. You own the solution from idea to publication. You do not wait for a task list. You analyze the site, find the opportunities, and execute the improvements that drive the biggest impact.

  • Strategic Content Architecture: You decide the format that converts. Sometimes an article is best, but often the customer needs a flow calculator, a comparison table, an upgraded category page, a tooltip, diagram, video, or a selection wizard. You will build the right content for the job to build our brand and convert users.

  • Technical Authority & Accuracy: You are responsible for the technical accuracy of all public-facing content. You must have high engineering knowledge to validate data, correct errors, and ensure our advice is sound. You are the filter that prevents AI hallucinations or inaccuracies from reaching the customer.

  • Build the Content Moat: You will create unique value that competitors and AI models cannot replicate. Go beyond text to produce proprietary assets like physical product benchmarks, expert interviews, and deep-dive technical diagrams or videos.

  • Optimize for the Audience: You will structure information to ensure our content ranks high for search engines, serves as a primary citation source for AI models, and provides clear, helpful guidance for humans (engineers, non-engineers, buyers, etc.).

  • Agile Adaptation: You will stay ahead of marketing trends and follow the data. If a content format stops working, you pivot. You track traffic and conversion metrics to continuously refine your strategy.

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • High Engineering Knowledge: You have a background in engineering, deep experience in technical industries, and can explain the physics of our products easily.

  • Builds With AI: You have designed and built content workflows using AI: research pipelines, structured drafting processes, automated publishing steps. You chose the tools, connected them, and own the quality of what comes out.

  • Outcome Owner: You are driven by results (traffic, conversion, revenue) rather than output (article or word count). You manage the roadmap and deliver end-to-end results.

  • Collaborative Investigator: You do not work in a silo. You actively partner with our Product and Operations teams to extract their internal expertise. You work with them and translate their knowledge into public-facing content that sets us apart from competitors.

  • Versatile Creator: You are comfortable switching formats and could work on writing a white paper, designing calculator logic, auditing category pages, and building dashboards to analyze results all in 1 week.

Why Choose Tameson?

  • Direct Business Impact: Your work directly correlates to sales. Publish the right guide and you can watch organic traffic and conversions move. There is a direct line between what you produce and company revenue.

  • Innovation: We are an aggressive, modern company. We want you to experiment with new formats, tools, and strategies.

  • Company culture: We value collaboration, professional growth, and fun. We regularly have company activities (online and offline) to stay connected and inspired.

  • Growth: We are scaling rapidly. As we expand, your professional opportunities grow.

Role Work Conditions

  • Employment type: Full time position (remote).

  • Working hours: Flexible work hours, with availability required Monday through Friday and a minimum overlap of 12:00–17:00 GMT+1.

  • Contract type: You will join as an independent contractor. To simplify hiring outside our registered countries, we engage global talent through freelance contracts.

Ready to define the future of industrial e-commerce?

If you have the technical mind to understand our products and the strategic mind to market them, apply today.

Position: Senior Manager, Peer-to-Peer Fundraising

Reports To: Vice President of Development

Summary: The Peer-to-Peer Fundraising Manager owns and leads the organization's Race4EveryKid virtual fundraiser and all peer-to-peer and crowdfunding campaigns from start to finish. This is a high-impact, results-driven role with a clear revenue mandate: grow Race4EveryKid to $1 million in gross revenue within three years. The ideal candidate comes from an organization where peer-to-peer fundraising is a primary revenue channel and brings hands-on experience across multiple P2P formats — virtual campaigns, walks, endurance events, DIY, and gaming/streaming fundraisers.

Primary Responsibilities:

Race4EveryKid Campaign Leadership

  • Serve as the internal owner of the Race4EveryKid virtual fundraiser, managing every phase from strategic planning through post-campaign analysis and reporting.
  • Develop and execute a multi-year growth strategy to scale the Race to $1 million (from $400,000) in revenue within three years; set annual revenue, participation, and team recruitment goals and adjust strategy proactively based on performance.
  • Provide input into annual campaign budgets, timelines, and revenue targets; produce detailed post-campaign analyses with recommendations for continuous improvement.

Participant & Team Engagement

  • Build and implement robust recruitment and retention strategies for individual participants, fundraising teams, and returning constituents; maintain year-round relationships with key participants and volunteers.
  • Develop and manage a corporate team program, cultivating relationships with companies to drive team participation, employee giving, and sustained brand investment in the campaign.
  • Design engagement touchpoints, coaching resources, and incentive programs that motivate participants to fundraise at higher levels; provide one-on-one coaching to top fundraisers and team captains on proven P2P best practices.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure participants have the resources, tools, and support needed to achieve their fundraising goals.

Sponsorship & Corporate Partnerships

  • Identify, cultivate, and secure event sponsorships for Race4EveryKid and other campaigns; develop sponsorship packages that deliver measurable value to corporate partners.
  • Build a pipeline of corporate partners beyond existing relationships; manage all sponsor deliverables, stewardship, and renewal conversations throughout the campaign cycle.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to increase campaign visibility, promote sponsorship recognition, and engage the broader community.

Peer-to-Peer & Crowdfunding Portfolio

  • Oversee all P2P and crowdfunding campaigns beyond Race4EveryKid, establishing best practices, revenue targets, and timelines for each.
  • Stay current on platform capabilities, industry trends, emerging P2P models, and competitor campaigns to continuously elevate performance.

Operations & Reporting

  • Manage campaign platforms, participant data, and CRM records to ensure accuracy and support data-driven decision-making.
  • Utilize platform and CRM data to track recruitment pipelines, fundraising progress, retention rates, and revenue performance; develop dashboards to evaluate program effectiveness and inform strategy

Qualifications, Skills and Capabilities:

  • Minimum 5 years of fundraising experience at an organization where peer-to-peer fundraising is a primary revenue channel, with direct, hands-on responsibility for campaign execution and growth.
  • Deep familiarity with the full spectrum of P2P fundraising models — endurance and walk events, virtual campaigns, DIY fundraising, and gaming/streaming; candidates should bring established best practices across multiple formats.
  • Demonstrated track record of growing P2P or virtual campaigns, ideally to six- or seven-figure revenue levels.
  • Experience securing sponsorships and managing corporate partnerships in a fundraising context.
  • Ability to influence and deliver results through a consultative, relationship-driven approach; comfortable engaging C-suite corporate contacts and grassroots participants alike.
  • Fluency with peer-to-peer fundraising platforms; experience with DonorDrive is a plus.
  • Data-driven mindset; able to analyze campaign metrics and translate insights into action.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented, and highly organized; able to manage a complex, multi-month campaign with minimal supervision.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred; passion for the mission required.

Compensation: To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the listed below.

S4S is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse staff and strongly encourages applications from candidates of color and other diverse backgrounds. Competitive salary. Benefits include medical insurance with 80% employer coverage, HRA account, 100% dental insurance & vision coverage, long-term disability, life, 401K with up to 6% employer match, professional development benefits, open FTO and paid parental leave.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

Do you thrive in the complex dance of managing multiple stakeholders whilst keeping your eye on the strategic prize? Zinier is searching for a hands-on, customer-obsessed Customer Success Manager who sees challenges as opportunities and customer success as the ultimate win.

In this high-impact role, you will be the trusted advisor who ensures our customers don't just implement our platform — they transform their operations with it. A core part of how you do that is through close partnership with our Solution Architects: you will co-own the customer engagement from a technical and strategic standpoint, bridging business outcomes with platform capability. You bring enough of a technical foundation to get into the details, earn credibility with IT and operations teams, and know when to escalate versus when to solve it yourself.

You are also an operator who thinks about leverage. You actively look for ways to automate repeatable parts of your role, experiment with AI tools, and approach workflow efficiency as a professional discipline.

This isn't a passive monitoring role. You will be in the trenches with customers, solving problems in real-time, spotting expansion opportunities, and constantly iterating on how we drive adoption and value realisation. You will need to zoom out to see the strategic vision, then zoom in to troubleshoot a workflow issue — sometimes in the same conversation.

Bring your consulting instincts, your technical curiosity, your hustler mentality, and your genuine passion for customer success with a measurable outcomes driven approach. This is your opportunity to shape how field service organisations transform, one successful deployment at a time.

Where the role is located

Anywhere in the UK, or Europe; able to collaborate with customers and teams in other countries or continents as needed, either remotely or in-person (occasional travel needed).

What the role offers

  • Own post-implementation customer journeys for a portfolio of accounts, driving adoption from go-live through sustained value delivery and measurable ROI achievement
  • Proactively monitor customer health (usage, sentiment, support tickets) and orchestrate interventions before issues escalate into churn risks
  • Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) that demonstrate ROI, identify expansion opportunities, and strengthen executive relationships
  • Navigate complex stakeholder environments, building trusted relationships across operational teams, IT, and service delivery leadership
  • Facilitate adoption activities (workshops, training, change management) that transform user resistance into platform advocacy and feature utilisation
  • Identify and qualify expansion opportunities based on customer maturity and usage patterns; own or support renewal processes to achieve NRR targets
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with PS on handoffs, Support on escalations, Product on roadmap feedback, and Sales on commercial opportunities
  • Automate your workflows by actively identifying automation opportunities, from health monitoring to engagement cadences and implement AI-driven approaches that improve scale and efficiency
  • Drive continuous improvement by developing repeatable playbooks, experimenting with engagement approaches, and contributing to evolving CS methodology

What you’ll bring to the role

  • 5-8 years in customer success, account management, or consulting within B2B SaaS; proven track record managing complex relationships and delivering measurable outcomes such as GRR, Expansion ARR and Adoption in fast-paced environments
  • Exceptional stakeholder orchestration skills: Navigate multi-layered organisations, influence without authority, and craft compelling narratives for diverse audiences
  • Strategic thinker with bias to action: Balance long-term vision with tactical execution; make decisions with 70% data, zoom in/out as needed
  • First-principles problem solver: Strong business acumen with grasp of operational metrics, ROI modelling, and data-driven decision making
  • Technical fluency and change management expertise: You have a technical foundation that lets you engage credibly in configuration-level conversations, partner effectively with Solution Architects, troubleshoot platform issues without needing a translator and deploy adoption interventions that overcome resistance
  • Field operations experience is a meaningful plus: exposure to field service management, industrial workforce operations, or enterprise operations platforms helps you speak your customers' language from day one
  • Hustler mentality with customer empathy: Resourceful, persistent, opportunistic; genuine passion for customer success with comfort navigating complexity
  • AI-forward mindset: you actively experiment with AI tools, look for automation opportunities within your own workflow, and treat efficiency improvement as a professional discipline, not a future aspiration
  • Excellent communication and facilitation: Experience leading workshops, executive presentations, and training; ability to distil complexity into actionable insights
  • Be Hungry. Be Humble. Be Honest. And Hustle.

Own the customer journey. Drive transformation. Be the reason our customers thrive.

Job Title: AI/ML Engineer
Department: IT Services
Reports To: IT Project Manager

Job Overview:

The AI/ML Engineer plays a critical role in designing, developing, and deploying machine learning models and AI-driven solutions to support strategic business initiatives. The role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams, including software engineering, data analytics, product development, and business stakeholders, to drive intelligent automation, data-driven decision-making, and advanced analytics capabilities.

The ideal candidate will have 3 to 5 years of experience in AI/ML model development, with a strong foundation in machine learning algorithms, data preprocessing, and deployment pipelines. Experience with Python, TensorFlow/PyTorch, and cloud-based ML services is essential.

Responsibilities:

1. Model Development and Optimization

  • Design, build, and deploy ML models for classification, regression, NLP, computer vision, or time-series forecasting.
  • Select appropriate algorithms and techniques based on business needs and data characteristics.
  • Continuously monitor and improve model performance using metrics and feedback loops.

2. Data Preparation and Feature Engineering

  • Clean, preprocess, and transform structured and unstructured datasets for training and inference.
  • Engineer and select relevant features to improve model accuracy and generalizability.
  • Collaborate with data engineers to ensure data quality and accessibility.

3. Model Deployment and MLOps

  • Package and deploy models using tools like Docker, Flask/FastAPI, and Kubernetes.
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for ML using platforms like MLflow, Airflow, or Kubeflow.
  • Monitor deployed models for drift, latency, and performance in production environments.

4. AI Solutions and Use Case Implementation

  • Work with business stakeholders to translate real-world problems into AI/ML use cases.
  • Prototype and test AI-driven solutions (e.g., recommendation engines, chatbots, fraud detection).
  • Contribute to proof-of-concept projects and assist in scaling successful models to production.

5. Research and Innovation

  • Stay updated with the latest research, frameworks, and tools in machine learning and AI.
  • Experiment with cutting-edge models (e.g., LLMs, transformers, generative AI) and assess their viability.
  • Promote innovation by recommending and implementing modern AI strategies.

6. Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with software developers, DevOps, data analysts, and domain experts for end-to-end solution delivery.
  • Translate technical insights into business value through clear documentation and presentations.

7. Documentation and Best Practices

  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for models, experiments, and pipelines.
  • Ensure reproducibility, scalability, and compliance with data governance policies.

Requirements:

Experience:

  • 3–5 years of hands-on experience in machine learning model development and deployment.
  • Proven track record of solving real-world problems using supervised, unsupervised, or deep learning methods.

Technical Skills:

Strong knowledge of:

  • Python and ML libraries (scikit-learn, pandas, NumPy, TensorFlow/PyTorch)
  • Model evaluation, hyperparameter tuning, and pipeline automation
  • REST APIs for model serving and integration

Familiarity with:

  • MLOps tools (MLflow, Airflow, DVC, Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Cloud ML services (AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, GCP AI Platform)
  • NLP or computer vision frameworks (e.g., Hugging Face, OpenCV)

Soft Skills:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
  • Curiosity, adaptability, and willingness to learn continuously.

Turn your practice operations expertise into practice growth expertise.

HIP is looking for a Practice Growth Advisor — someone who's worked inside an orthodontic practice (or a dental practice with strong ortho exposure) and knows exactly what makes patients show up, say yes to treatment, and stay. If that's you, we want to teach you the marketing side and turn you loose on real results.

This is not a traditional marketing account manager role.

The best fit has lived inside practice operations — as a practice manager, practice consultant, or ops-focused practice leader — and wants to use that hard-won experience to help owners and teams grow. You don't need to walk in as a digital marketing expert. We'll teach you HIP's marketing strategy, reporting, and campaign language. What we can't teach is your ability to read a practice, coach a team, hold people accountable, communicate with confidence, and obsess over the details that actually move the needle.

As a Practice Growth Advisor, you'll partner directly with orthodontic and dental practices to connect the dots — marketing, lead response, scheduling, show rates, treatment coordination, patient follow-up, conversion to start — and show partners exactly what's working, what isn't, and what to do next to drive growth and ROI.

If you're tenacious, sharp on the details, proactive, and genuinely energized by helping practices win, this role was built for you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • Manage a portfolio of 35-40 orthodontic and dental partners while maintaining a high-touch, white-glove partner experience.
  • Lead 10 to 12 weekly partner calls focused on growth strategy, marketing performance, opportunity conversion, scheduling, CRM usage, front desk execution, treatment coordinator performance, and partner accountability.
  • Review key performance indicators across the full opportunity funnel, including lead volume, scheduled appointments, show rate, pending patients, starts, lost opportunities, and ROI.
  • Coach practice owners, front desk teams, scheduling teams, and treatment coordinators on the behaviors and systems that improve conversion.
  • Help partners understand how HIP’s marketing strategy connects to practice growth, patient starts, and revenue.
  • Learn and present HIP’s marketing strategy, including paid media, SEO, website performance, lead generation, creative strategy, and reporting insights.
  • Identify performance issues and friction points quickly, then develop clear action plans to improve results.
  • Maintain proactive communication with partners, including timely follow-up, clear next steps, and a 2 to 3 hour response window during business hours.
  • Document calls, action items, partner updates, risks, and next steps in HighLevel (CRM) and ClickUp (Project Management Tool).
  • Collaborate with HIP’s Paid Media, SEO, Web, Creative, Sales, and Support teams to ensure partner needs are clearly communicated and addressed.
  • Identify at-risk partners early and help lead 30/60/90 day plans to improve account health and retention.
  • Show up with urgency, ownership, precision, and a genuine commitment to helping partners grow.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • You have hands-on experience in the orthodontic space (dental experience also considered) and know how practice operations drive growth.
  • You understand how front desk, scheduling, and treatment coordinator teams operate — and can spot when a practice has a lead, scheduling, follow-up, conversion, or accountability problem.
  • You're comfortable coaching people, giving direct feedback, and pushing teams to improve.
  • You're highly organized, with a natural instinct for tracking details, next steps, and follow-through.
  • You're proactive — you act without waiting to be told.
  • You're hungry to learn marketing strategy and can turn data into clear, practical recommendations.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift quickly.
  • You speak with confidence to doctors, executives, owners, and practice teams alike.
  • You take ownership of partner outcomes, especially when results fall short.
  • You hold yourself to high standards for communication, organization, and execution.

WHAT YOU NEED TO HAVE

  • 3+ years in orthodontic practice operations (candidates with dental practice operations experience will also be considered).
  • Experience coaching, training, or managing dental/orthodontic teams.
  • Strong grasp of the patient journey, from inquiry to scheduled appointment to consultation to start.
  • Ability to read performance data, spot trends, and turn insights into clear action steps.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with high attention to detail and strong organization.
  • Ability to manage 35–40 partner relationships with timely communication and follow-through.
  • Comfortable using or learning tools like HighLevel, ClickUp, Slack, Zoom, Google Workspace, PandaDoc, and reporting dashboards.
  • Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated, distraction-free remote workspace.

COMPENSATION

This role includes base pay plus commission tied to partner retention and account performance.

BENEFITS

  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental Insurance
  • Health Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • PTO eligibility after 90 days of hire (10 vacation days the first year of service, unlimited PTO starting year two, flexible partial days, and sick/ personal days)
  • Remote position (You MUST be located in the US.)

SCHEDULE

  • 8 am- 5 pm CST
  • Monday to Friday

You will work across feature development, frontend architecture, API integration, performance optimisation, and platform improvements while collaborating closely with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and QA. Develop reusable, accessible UI components using a shared design system.

Integrate frontend applications with backend APIs and platform services.

Build and maintain complex forms, workflows, and data-driven user interfaces.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software from design through production.

Experience designing reusable component libraries and scalable frontend architectures.

Ability to reason about state ownership, derived state, effects, and component responsibilities.

TypeScript

Strong experience writing production applications in TypeScript.

Comfortable working with strict typing, discriminated unions, utility types, generics, and advanced type inference.

Experience using TypeScript to improve application design and developer experience.

TanStack Router

guards, and code splitting.

TanStack Query

TanStack Form

You value maintainability over cleverness.

You understand when to introduce abstractions and when to keep solutions simple.

You understand the difference between local UI state, URL state, and server state, and choose the appropriate tool for each.
