raw.excerpt: Position OverviewCeresti Health is seeking a compassionate and motivated Dementia Caregiver Coach to provide remote support, coaching, and education to family caregivers of loved ones living with dementia.
raw.description:
Position Overview

Ceresti Health is seeking a compassionate and motivated Dementia Caregiver Coach to provide remote support, coaching, and education to family caregivers of loved ones living with dementia. This vital role is at the heart of our innovative Caregiver Support Program, a first-of-its-kind digital health model designed to improve health outcomes, reduce avoidable hospitalizations, and enhance the experience of caregiving for families impacted by Alzheimer's disease and related dementias.

The ideal candidate will have experience working with individuals living with dementia, be confident managing a caseload, and excel at building relationships through empathy, encouragement, and education. If you’re passionate about making a real difference in the lives of others and want to join a mission-driven team, this position is for you.

Why This Role Matters

At Ceresti, we believe that family caregivers are essential members of their loved one’s care team. Our program empowers caregivers with the knowledge, tools, and emotional support they need to provide the best possible care for their loved ones. Coaches are a trusted lifeline for families navigating the challenges of dementia care. You will be part of a meaningful cause—improving caregiver well-being, enhancing patient outcomes, and driving systemic change in dementia care.

‍

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver high-quality, person-centered coaching to family caregivers of individuals living with dementia, tailored to their unique challenges.
  • Use Ceresti’s proprietary technology platform to manage daily workflow, track caregiver progress, and document caregiver interactions.
  • Initiate and maintain consistent outbound engagement to establish trust and build strong, long-term relationships with assigned caregivers.
  • Educate caregivers on the dementia disease process, common behavioral symptoms, safety strategies, and techniques for managing stress and preventing burnout.
  • Coach caregivers through emotionally complex scenarios, such as end-of-life conversations, transitions to facility care, or family conflict around care decisions.
  • Guide caregivers in care planning, appointment preparation, accessing community-based resources and care coordination, helping them communicate effectively with healthcare providers and navigate the healthcare system.
  • Meet or exceed performance metrics related to caregiver engagement, satisfaction, and program outcomes.
  • Attend and contribute to regular team huddles, trainings, and case reviews, sharing insights and best practices with peers and leadership.
  • Participate in quality improvement initiatives, including pilot studies, internal feedback loops, and caregiver experience evaluations.
  • Other duties as assigned.

‍

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience working professionally with older adults or persons living with dementia.
  • Direct caregiving experience (personal or professional) with persons with cognitive impairment.
  • Fluency in English.
  • Must be eligible to work in the U.S.
  • Ability to work independently in a fully remote setting.

‍

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in psychology, social work, human services, or a related field.
  • Direct caregiving experience (personal or professional) with persons with cognitive impairment.
  • Experience with caregiver support, family systems, or dementia-related behavioral challenges.
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and active listening skills.
  • Comfort navigating technology and learning new platforms (Mac/IOS).
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities.
  • Previous experience in a HIPAA-compliant setting.
  • Empathetic, resourceful, and confident managing emotionally complex situations.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, change-driven environment.
Salary: $57,000 / year

wellness and self-care


About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

What you will be doing

  • KPIs - Consistently achieve sales targets
  • Outreach - Calling key decision-makers using phone, email & social touches with the goal of bringing on new business (there may be some in-person meetings as appropriate)
  • Selling - Present, promote and sell products and services through product demos to prospective and existing partners
  • Sales Cycle - Managing the entire sales process from prospecting to close
  • Partnering - Perform cost-benefit and needs analysis with existing/potential partners in order to align our solutions to their needs and business objectives
  • Collaboration - Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless partner experience
  • Market Trends - Provide feedback about ongoing trends in the industry
  • Leads - Contact 100% of qualified inbound leads in a timely manner, and document all call outcomes in the CRM
  • Business Partnering - Serve as a lead point of contact for partners on all commercial activities
  • This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

What we are looking for

  • Experience - Minimum 1 years of solid B2B sales with a track record of success
  • Industry - SaaS, online marketplaces, or payment platforms is highly desirable
  • Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder
  • Organised - You can multitask, prioritise and manage time effectively
  • Curiosity - You are naturally curious and have a desire to continually grow and develop

Added bonus

  • Bi-lingual - Fluency in Portuguese & English.
  • Any other another language or Spanish is a bonus!
  • Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry
  • At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview Process

  • Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins)
  • Skills & Experience - Video/In-person interview with Head of Sales (Europe) (45 mins)
  • Presentation - Online Case Study for 60 minutes with Team Lead of Business Development & General Manager of Spain.
    • We aim to finalise the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks.
  • Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe.

Inclusive workforce

At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.

Important Notice for Applicants:
At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included.

Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment.

Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays.

Why Bixal?

Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement.

Our values:

  • People-First: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work.

  • Collaboration and Transparency: Valuing teamwork and open communication.

  • Growth Mindset: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement.

  • Creating Lasting Impact: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change.

About the role:

In this role, you'll build and maintain the self-service developer portal and developer-facing tooling that make our client’s platform golden paths easy to find and use. Embedded within the Developer Experience team, you'll work in direct proximity to the team's UX researcher and content specialist, translating research-backed interaction patterns and onboarding flows into working, instrumented software within the same sprint cadence as the research that defines what developers need.

This role offers you a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a mission-critical federal platform that aligns with Bixal's mission of delivering innovative, human-centered solutions. At Bixal, we support your professional journey, ensuring your experience reflects our purpose-driven culture and prepares you for future success.

Location:

This is a fully remote position that can be worked anywhere in the U.S. While most of the work is expected to be conducted virtually, there is potential for occasional travel for on-site meetings and working sessions (Washington, D.C.) at the discretion of the client. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship. U.S. citizenship is required for this position due to contractual requirement.

Compensation:

The salary range for this role is $135,000 – $138,000. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain the self-service developer portal and developer-facing tooling for a federal agency’s platform.

  • Design and automate cross-platform workflows spanning source control, CI/CD, issue tracking, observability, and collaboration tools to reduce manual developer toil.

  • Build reusable automation patterns (APIs, bots, webhooks, event-driven services, IaC, internal tooling) that standardize engineering workflows.

  • Integrate identity, access management, provisioning, and compliance controls across SaaS platforms to enable secure self-service.

  • Monitor and maintain workflow reliability, including failure detection, retry strategies, and audit logging.

  • Translate research-backed interaction patterns and onboarding flows into working, instrumented software.

  • Deliver platform improvements that measurably improve developer experience (reduced setup time, faster deployment cycles, improved release confidence).

  • Collaborate closely with the UX and documentation specialists on the team.

  • Other relevant duties as qualified and trained to perform.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree and at least 8 years of related experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Demonstrated hands-on experience designing and automating cross-platform workflows spanning source control, CI/CD pipelines, issue tracking, observability, and collaboration tools.

  • Proven ability to build reusable automation patterns (APIs, bots, webhooks, event-driven services, IaC, internal tooling).

  • Experience integrating identity, access management, provisioning, and compliance controls across SaaS platforms for secure self-service.

  • Strong capability in monitoring and maintaining workflow reliability, including failure detection, retry strategies, and audit logging.

  • Able to independently deliver platform improvements that measurably improve developer experience while preventing tool sprawl and fragmentation.

  • This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Tier 4 / High Risk Public Trust determination in support of a federal government contract.

Nice to Have Skills and Experience:

  • Experience building internal developer portals or platform-as-product tooling.

  • Familiarity with GitLab, Jira, Confluence, Datadog, and Figma-integrated toolchains.

  • Experience applying human-centered design inputs directly into software delivery.

  • Exposure to AI-assisted development tools (e.g., GSA USAi, AWS Bedrock, Microsoft Copilot).

How We Support Our Team:

  • Medical/dental/vision benefits

Ability to create and deliver influential large-scale project communications with clarity, confidence, and enthusiasm. The Project Manager is responsible for exceeding client expectations through superior implementation and delivery. The Project Manager oversees small to mid-size level projects, develops comprehensive project plans and manages project team and stakeholders throughout the complete project life cycle, and manages ongoing customer communication. This role supports the project team in creation of project delivery strategies, including project plans, work breakdown structures, and resource management. This role requires the ability to lead and motivate people, encourage teamwork, the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, and possesses a clear vision of what determines a successful solution for the work effort and for the company.

Responsibilities & Duties

  • Assist with facilitating communications, scheduling, business requirements/gap analysis, and testing.

  • Confirmation that project documentation is delivered with high quality and timelines.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Must be passionate about contributing to an organization focused on continuously improving consumer experiences. Experience leading and managing IT projects following SDLC Methodologies, Agile, SCRUM, SDLC / Waterfall best practice.

  • Proficient with MS Excel, MS Word, MS PowerPoint, MS Project, and MS Visio

  • Familiarity with project, program, and agile tools

Behavioral Competencies

Analytical: Evaluate different construction methods and options in order to determine the most cost-effective solutions or recommendations that meet the required specifications

Self-confidence: Confident, without an ego, to have both the conviction and willingness to make decisions as well as the confidence to seek collaborative solutions

Strong work ethic: Ability to overcome setbacks and enthusiastically persist until ambitious goals are achieved—must be resourceful, creative and innovative.

Accountable: Results-oriented team player who leads by example, holds self-accountable for performance, takes ownership, and champions efforts with enthusiasm and conviction.

About the Program:

Every year, we sponsor 2 remote UX apprentices from anywhere in the world to join us for 7 months, either in the fall or spring seasons or online. Our UX apprentices work through the end-to-end UX design and UX research process for a startup idea of their choice that will help them attract hiring managers in that topic space or industry.

Apprentices take our program for free and receive 1:1 mentorship throughout the 7-month program. Alumni UX apprentices go on to make between $85,000 -$130,000 in UX design, product design, UX research, or service design roles after they complete the program.

We are committed to helping women, immigrants, POC, and LGBTQ folks break into tech and land 6-figure UX jobs. We help you land 6-figure UX jobs or coach you till you get it.

Apprenticeship Requirements:

This apprenticeship program is open to new grads and UX career changers alike! Here are some apprenticeship requirements to keep in mind before applying:

  • Interested in creative career paths in UX research, UX design, product design or service design

  • Willing to commit 5-10 hours of work per week to complete program deliverables

  • Willing to attend 2-3 hour weekend lectures to learn the end-to-end design process OR willing to complete online video course modules

  • Open to feedback from UX mentors and demonstrates a willingness to revise design work

Apprenticeship Program Learnings:

  • Build digital products and services 0-1

  • Lead end-to-end design process for a startup idea or topic of your choice

  • Lead product scoping and feature scoping, as well as entire project management

  • Identify target market for product and position product for launch success

  • Develop a business model for the product or service and demonstrate how the product/service will scale as the business model scales

  • Lead discovery research by managing user recruitment, creating research plans, writing interview guides, leading 8-16 discovery interviews, and synthesizing interview insights

  • Deliver a compelling UX design and business pitch for your startup idea, showcasing both qualitative and quantitative data to justify the problem space and the solution

  • Tell a compelling story about users by showcasing user types, personas, stakeholder maps, journey maps, process maps, service blueprints, ideation matrixes, sketches, wireframes, UX workflows, prototypes and other visual deliverables

  • Lead user testing of wireframes and prototypes to improve product/service usability and constantly iterate on your startup idea

  • Design a unique design system for your solution from scratch, creating components, a style guide, and branding for your solution

  • Analyze direct and indirect competitors to clearly articulate your solution’s differentiators and why your solution is innovative and more likely to succeed over competing options

  • Consult with startups to create a scope of work and fulfill UX research, UX design, product design and service design work based on your scope of work.

How to Apply:

Please fill out our application form to apply for UX Womansponsoring your participation in the program. The application takes 5 minutes to complete and will ask you to send in your LinkedIn profile and resume, as well as ask you about why you are interested in this program. You do NOT need to have a UX resume or portfolio to apply- we consider folks who are at the very beginning of their career change, who are still exploring multiple career options.

You will receive UX tips and challenges via email to help you with your transition into UX and will be contacted by us if you are being considered for the apprentice program. Once contacted, you will go through a brief interview process before joining the cohort. Due to the large volume of applicants, we cannot contact all applicants about their application status.If you don’t hear from us about an interview within 2 months of applying, please consider your application closed. We consider applicants on a rolling basis.

raw.description:
💻We Are Hiring - People & Culture Operations Specialist| 100% Remote

We are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and detail-oriented People & Culture Operations Specialist to support the day-to-day HR operations of our global team.

This role will work closely with the Head of People & Culture to manage and improve key HR processes, including employee documentation, HR systems, payroll coordination, recruitment support, training, and employee-related operations.

We’re looking for someone with hands-on HR or People Operations experience who can take ownership of recurring processes, stay on top of deadlines and follow-ups, identify process gaps, and independently drive tasks to completion.

The ideal candidate is dependable, detail-oriented, and comfortable working with employees and managers across different countries and time zones. Strong communication skills, discretion in handling confidential information, and the ability to manage multiple priorities are essential.

Key Responsibilities:

HR Operations & Employee Lifecycle

  • Support the Head of People & Culture with the day-to-day operation of the global People & Culture function.
  • Coordinate and administer employee lifecycle processes from hire through departure.
  • Prepare and administer offer letters, employment documentation, promotion letters, salary change letters, employment change documentation, probation-related documentation, and other routine employee correspondence.
  • Coordinate onboarding and offboarding activities and ensure required actions are completed by the appropriate internal stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate and complete employee records and documentation.
  • Track employee changes and ensure they are reflected accurately across applicable HR and payroll systems.
  • Maintain HR trackers, calendars, checklists, and other operational tools to ensure important activities and deadlines are not missed.
  • Support annual and recurring People & Culture processes as required.
  • Maintain confidentiality and exercise appropriate judgment when handling sensitive employee information.

HRIS & BambooHR Administration

Serve as a primary administrator and operational owner of BambooHR, including:

  • Maintaining accurate employee records and employment information.
  • Processing new hires, employee changes, promotions, compensation changes, departures, and other employee lifecycle transactions.
  • Administering time-off policies and employee leave records.
  • Maintaining organizational and reporting information.
  • Supporting BambooHR workflows, approvals, documentation, and employee records.
  • Supporting the BambooHR Applicant Tracking System and recruitment workflows.
  • Running and maintaining HR reports.
  • Conducting regular data reviews to identify missing, inaccurate, or outdated information.
  • Troubleshooting routine employee and manager questions regarding BambooHR.
  • Identifying opportunities to better utilize BambooHR functionality and automate manual HR processes.
  • Creating and documenting consistent procedures for HRIS administration.

Prior BambooHR experience is strongly preferred; however, candidates with significant experience administering another HRIS and the ability to learn new systems quickly will also be considered.

Payroll Administration

Support and coordinate payroll administration for employees in the United States and United Kingdom, including:

  • Preparing and reviewing payroll-related employee changes.
  • Coordinating new hires and terminations with payroll.
  • Processing salary increases, promotions, bonuses, and other compensation changes.
  • Ensuring leave and other employee status changes are appropriately reflected in payroll.
  • Reviewing payroll information for accuracy before processing.
  • Maintaining payroll change documentation and supporting appropriate internal approvals.
  • Identifying discrepancies and coordinating corrections.
  • Maintaining accurate records of payroll changes and effective dates.
  • Partnering with Finance, payroll providers, and the Head of People & Culture as needed.
  • Experience supporting U.S. and/or UK payroll administration is strongly preferred.

Leave of Absence & Time-Off Administration

  • Coordinate the administrative aspects of employee leaves of absence.
  • Maintain accurate leave documentation, dates, correspondence, and HRIS records.
  • Support maternity, parental, medical, and other applicable leave processes.
  • Ensure appropriate documentation and approvals are received and maintained.
  • Track important leave dates and proactively follow up on required actions.
  • Administer company time-off policies within BambooHR.
  • Respond to routine employee questions regarding time-off processes and policies.
  • Escalate complex leave, legal, or employee-relations matters to the Head of People & Culture.
  • Ensure leave and time-off administration is consistent with internal policies and established procedures.

Recruitment & Hiring Coordination

  • Provide operational support throughout the recruitment and hiring process.
  • Schedule interviews across multiple time zones and coordinate candidate availability with hiring teams.
  • Maintain candidate records and recruitment activity within the ATS.
  • Support candidate communications throughout the interview process.
  • Coordinate interview schedules and follow up with interviewers as needed.
  • Prepare offer documentation and support the transition from candidate to new employee.
  • Coordinate pre-employment and onboarding requirements.
  • Maintain recruitment trackers and ensure candidates continue moving through the process in a timely manner.
  • Support the Head of People & Culture and hiring managers with other recruitment activities as required.

Training & Compliance Administration

  • Administer the company's employee training platform.
  • Assign required training to employees.
  • Track completion of mandatory and role-specific training.
  • Follow up with employees and managers regarding outstanding training.
  • Maintain accurate training records and completion reports.
  • Support the rollout of new policies, procedures, and required acknowledgements.
  • Maintain records of employee policy acknowledgements and other required documentation.
  • Assist with ongoing compliance tracking and reporting.

People & Culture Inbox & Employee Support

  • Take primary operational responsibility for monitoring the People & Culture inbox.
  • Ensure employee and manager questions are acknowledged and addressed in a timely manner.
  • Resolve routine HR and policy questions where appropriate.
  • Route requests to the appropriate People & Culture team member or internal stakeholder when necessary.
  • Track outstanding requests through resolution rather than simply forwarding them.
  • Follow up proactively when information or action is required from another party.
  • Identify urgent, sensitive, or complex employee matters and promptly escalate them to the Head of People & Culture.
  • Provide employees with a professional, helpful, and responsive experience when interacting with People & Culture.

Policies, Procedures & HR Compliance

  • Develop a strong working knowledge of company employee handbooks, People & Culture policies, and internal procedures.
  • Assist with the consistent administration of established HR policies.
  • Maintain and update HR documentation, templates, procedures, and employee-facing materials.
  • Support policy rollouts and employee acknowledgement processes.
  • Maintain organized records of current policies and procedures.
  • Ideally bring prior exposure to U.S. and UK employment practices and employment law.
  • Recognize situations that require escalation rather than attempting to independently resolve complex legal or employee-relations matters.

Process Improvement & Organization

A major component of this role will be helping the People & Culture function become increasingly organized, efficient, documented, and scalable.

The People & Culture Operations Specialist will:

  • Review existing processes and identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures, checklists, templates, trackers, and process documentation.
  • Create repeatable processes for recurring People & Culture activities.
  • Identify manual processes that could be simplified, standardized, or automated.
  • Help establish clear ownership and deadlines for recurring activities.
  • Maintain organized electronic employee and departmental records.
  • Help ensure People & Culture information can be easily located, understood, and handed over when necessary.
  • Proactively identify outstanding actions and follow through until they are completed.

Must-Have Skills:

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in Human Resources, People Operations, HR Operations, or a related HR function..
  • Good English communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate technical/HR decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently execute HR administrative and operational processes, including employee records, documentation, trackers, onboarding/offboarding, training or learning-management platforms, and recurring HR activities.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Word, including working with spreadsheets, employee data, reports, trackers, and HR documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with an HRIS and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), or employee management system; experience with BambooHR is strongly preferred, with transferable experience in comparable HRIS platforms also acceptable.
  • Strong HR data accuracy, documentation, organization, and confidentiality skills, including maintaining employee records and handling sensitive compensation, payroll, leave, and employment information.
  • Demonstrated ownership, follow-through, prioritization, and problem-solving in managing multiple HR processes, deadlines, stakeholders, and recurring activities with minimal supervision.

🕒 Working Hours: 6 PM - 2 AM Philippine Time

🚀 Engagement: Full-time engagement

💎 What You’ll Get

  • Above-market compensation.
  • Long-term opportunity.
  • Opportunity to shape user-facing experiences that reach thousands of users.
  • Collaborative, growth-oriented work culture.
  • Enjoy a Signing Bonus of PHP 20,000 upon joining!

🚨 Don’t Meet Every Requirement?

No worries! If you’re a strong candidate with the right experience and a willingness to learn and grow, we encourage you to apply. We’re always looking for exceptional people—even if you don’t check every box.

💬 Referral Program – Earn While You Help!

Know someone who’s a great fit for this role?

Refer a candidate and earn up to ₱20,000 per successful hire. There’s no limit—refer as many qualified developers as you like!

raw.excerpt: Who We Are Liberum exists to deliver in the environments where most firms struggle.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Liberum exists to deliver in the environments where most firms struggle. Our clients are public sector agencies navigating enterprise-scale transformations in politically complex, high-stakes environments where the margin for error is thin, and the consequences of failure are public. We believe clients deserve real ownership, not warm bodies and hope.

We’re a team first. Not a loose collection of consultants sharing a logo, but a genuine team that pushes each other’s thinking, pressure-tests each other’s work, and shows up when engagements get hard. The people we hire make the team better, not just their own deliverables.

We’re also building an AI-forward consulting practice. Our consultants don’t treat AI as a novelty or a side experiment. They integrate it into how they plan, analyze, build, and deliver. AI is a force multiplier at Liberum, and every practitioner is expected to wield it with the same rigor they bring to their core discipline.

If you’re looking for a comfortable seat and a steady paycheck, this isn’t the role. If you want to be part of a team that does hard things extraordinarily well, with every available advantage. Keep reading.

The Role

This is a dual-capacity position: you will provide both project management leadership and business analysis expertise to support large-scale Washington State ERP initiatives. This is not two half-roles stitched together. It’s a senior-level position for a seasoned professional who can seamlessly shift between driving project delivery and performing rigorous business analysis within the same engagement, often in the same week.

The right candidate brings deep public sector experience, hands-on ERP implementation knowledge, and direct Workday expertise. On the PM side, you bring genuine planning rigor: resource-loaded schedules, dependency mapping, and the discipline to keep plans current and actionable, not decorative artifacts that gather dust. On the BA side, you go beyond documenting requirements to identify gaps and risks the client hasn’t recognized, and you translate complex operational realities into clear, actionable specifications that technical teams can actually build from.

You are an AI-enabled consultant. You use AI tools daily to work faster and smarter, whether that’s rapidly synthesizing meeting notes and interview data into requirements artifacts, using AI to identify patterns and risks in project data, building executive-ready deliverables in a fraction of the time, or automating the repetitive analytical work that bogs down traditional consultants. You don’t see AI as separate from your PM and BA practice. It’s woven into how you operate, and it’s one of the reasons you deliver at a level your peers can’t match.

You operate with an ownership mentality. You drive work forward, take responsibility for outcomes beyond your immediate scope, and build clarity when things are ambiguous or off-track, without waiting for direction. You’re comfortable delivering hard truths to executive stakeholders with data and a solution already in hand. You understand that making your value visible to the client is as important as delivering it.

As a Liberum team member, you collaborate fully, communicate proactively, and never operate in isolation. You see the big picture while owning your piece of it. You make the people and engagements around you better.

What You’ll Do

Project Management & Delivery Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end project management for complex, multi-workstream engagements including scope, schedule, budget, risk, and issue management
  • Develop, maintain, and execute detailed MS Project plans with dependencies, resource loading, and elaborated tasks; apply hybrid Agile/Waterfall approaches appropriate to the engagement context
  • Drive clarity and alignment when project conditions are ambiguous, off-track, or politically complex, including developing recovery plans and realignment strategies when things go sideways
  • Facilitate project status reporting, executive briefings, and governance checkpoints
  • Deliver status updates and executive reporting in visually compelling formats that tell the right story for the right audience, not just data dumps
  • Identify and proactively manage project risks and dependencies across interconnected workstreams

Business Analysis & Requirements

  • Elicit, document, and validate business and functional requirements through structured interviews, workshops, and process observation
  • Develop and maintain business process flow diagrams, gap analyses, use cases, and other analytical artifacts that drive clarity, not just check boxes
  • Assess current state and future state business processes to identify impacts, risks, and opportunities associated with system and operational changes
  • Translate complex business requirements into clear, actionable specifications for technical teams and system integrators, specifications they can actually build from without three rounds of clarification
  • Support configuration, testing, and validation activities related to ERP/Workday implementation workstreams, including UAT planning and execution

AI-Enabled Delivery

  • Use AI tools to rapidly synthesize meeting notes, interview transcripts, and workshop outputs into structured requirements documents, gap analyses, and decision frameworks, compressing days of manual synthesis into hours
  • Use AI for project data analysis: identifying risk patterns across workstreams, surfacing schedule dependencies, forecasting resource conflicts, and generating early-warning indicators that inform proactive decision-making
  • Use AI to accelerate the creation of executive-ready deliverables: status reports, briefing decks, business cases, and analytical artifacts, at a quality and speed that traditional approaches can’t match
  • Use AI as an analytical partner to pressure-test requirements, validate business process logic, identify specification gaps, and stress-test assumptions before they reach technical teams
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging AI tools and techniques that improve PM and BA delivery, and share innovations with the Liberum team to raise the collective capability

Stakeholder & Relationship Management

  • Manage relationships with executive sponsors, steering committees, and cross-functional stakeholders across state agency environments
  • Engage and build foundational relationships with customers, project sponsors, vendors, and external stakeholders
  • Coordinate across vendor, state agency, and internal Liberum team members to ensure integrated delivery
  • Proactively communicate project progress, risks, and value delivered to client stakeholders, ensuring visibility into team contributions throughout the engagement

Team & Client Development

  • Coach and mentor client-side staff to build internal PM and BA capability where applicable
  • Collaborate with OCM, training, and communications teams to ensure PM and BA outputs support adoption and readiness activities
  • Identify opportunities to create additional client value throughout the engagement lifecycle, not just fulfill the SOW, but actively look for ways to make the client better

Requirements

What We Require

These aren’t suggestions. If you can’t back each of these up with specific examples, this isn’t the right fit yet.

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent professional experience
  • 5+ years of combined experience in project management and business analysis roles, with demonstrated senior-level performance in both functions, not just titles but outcomes you can walk us through
  • Direct experience supporting or delivering at least one major ERP implementation (Workday, SAP, Oracle, PeopleSoft, or equivalent)
  • Workday experience: functional knowledge of one or more Workday modules (HCM, Finance, Payroll, etc.) preferred, with hands-on configuration or testing experience ideal
  • Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects in highly regulated or politically sensitive environments, where the org chart doesn’t tell you who actually makes decisions
  • Experience facilitating executive-level stakeholder engagement, including steering committees and sponsor briefings
  • Proficiency in developing business process documentation, requirements artifacts, and gap analysis deliverables that drive action, not shelf-ware
  • Experience conducting business interviews and leading client workshops at both operational and leadership levels
  • Active, daily use of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or equivalent) integrated into your PM and BA workflow, not occasional experimentation, but a fundamental part of how you work. You should be able to demonstrate specific examples of how AI has changed your delivery speed, quality, or analytical depth.
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI for document synthesis, requirements analysis, data pattern recognition, risk identification, and deliverable creation in a professional consulting context
  • Comfort prompting and directing AI tools effectively. You understand how to get high-quality, contextually appropriate outputs and know the limitations of AI-generated content
  • Intellectual curiosity and initiative around emerging AI capabilities. Proactively experiment with new tools and bring innovations to your team, not wait for someone to assign them
  • Strong writing skills: the ability to synthesize complex information into clear, concise deliverables for both technical audiences and executive stakeholders
  • Hybrid methodology fluency: ability to blend Agile and Waterfall approaches pragmatically based on what the project and client actually need
  • Proficiency in MS Project or equivalent scheduling tools, including dependency mapping and resource-loaded plans
  • Professional courage to deliver difficult findings and recommendations with data, grace, and actionable solutions, not just flag problems, but bring answers
  • Proven ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively within a remote or hybrid team environment
  • Exceptional client relationship management skills
  • PMP certification or equivalent project management credential preferred
  • PMI-PBA or CBAP certification a plus

What Sets You Apart

Not required, but these will move you to the front of the line.

  • Master’s Degree in Business, Public Administration, Information Systems, or related field
  • Consulting experience with public sector clients
  • Experience with COTS implementation in public sector environments
  • Familiarity with Washington State procurement and contracting processes
  • Experience working alongside or managing SI (System Integrator) teams on large-scale ERP programs
  • Prosci or equivalent OCM certification
  • Experience building custom AI workflows, prompt libraries, or automated analytical pipelines that measurably improved consulting delivery
  • Familiarity with AI-powered project analytics, predictive scheduling tools, or automated reporting solutions
  • Track record of introducing AI tools or practices to a team or client organization and driving adoption

Benefits

Why Liberum

  • You’ll work alongside people who are as good at this as you are, a team where excellence is the baseline, not the exception
  • The work is real: complex, politically nuanced, enterprise-scale ERP transformations that actually matter to the State of Washington
  • We’re building an AI-forward practice. You’ll be part of a team that’s redefining how consulting is done, not just doing it the same way with better tools
  • Comprehensive benefits: full medical, dental, life, and short-term disability coverage, plus 401k with 4% match (no vesting period)
  • Competitive compensation: $140,000–$160,000 annually based on experience
  • Generous PTO: 15 days (0–5 years) or 20 days (5+ years), plus 9 paid holidays and WA state sick leave accrual
  • Bonus Leave program for employees who go above and beyond.

Liberum is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate candidates on their ability to do extraordinary work.

raw.description:
Senior AI Data Engineer

Job Summary

We are seeking a Senior AI Data Engineer to design and operate the data foundation that our AI systems depend on. This role owns the movement, modeling, and quality of data from source systems through the warehouse and into the retrieval and feature layers that power LLM pipelines, agentic workflows, and analytical products.

The ideal candidate is a rigorous software engineer first and a data specialist second: someone who models a warehouse deliberately, writes production Python that other engineers can extend, and treats pipelines as versioned, tested, observable software rather than scripts.

This role partners closely with the AI/ML Data Scientist, who owns model behavior and retrieval strategy.

The boundary: you own the pipeline, the schema, and the guarantees; they own the algorithm, the prompt, and the evaluation.

Required Qualifications

5-10+ years in software engineering or data engineering, with substantial time in production data platform work.

Data warehousing: demonstrable command of Kimball dimensional modeling - not just familiarity with the vocabulary, but the judgment to choose a grain, resolve a many-to-many relationship, and know when to denormalize. Working knowledge of alternative approaches (Data Vault, One Big Table, Inman) and the tradeoffs against Kimball.

SQL: expert-level - window functions, CTEs, query plan reading, and performance tuning on a columnar warehouse.

Python: expert-level, production-grade - typing, packaging, dependency management, testing.

Design: SOLID and domain-driven design applied in real systems, with examples you can walk through.

Orchestration: Airflow, Prefect, Dagster, or equivalent, in production.

Cloud: expert-level on AWS, Azure, or GCP - storage, compute, IAM, networking, and cost management.

Platform: containerization, Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE), and CI/CD.

Experience with lakehouse table formats (Iceberg, Delta Lake, Hudi) and their maintenance characteristics: compaction, snapshot expiry, schema and partition evolution.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building the data layer beneath production RAG systems, including hybrid search infrastructure and index freshness guarantees.

Streaming systems: Kafka, Kinesis, Flink, or Spark Structured Streaming.

dbt or an equivalent transformation and testing framework.

Data quality tooling (Great Expectations, Soda, or similar) and catalog/lineage platforms.

Familiarity with the model-facing side of the stack - MLflow, Weights & Biases, feature stores - sufficient to collaborate credibly with data scientists.

Working knowledge of a second language: TypeScript, Java, Go, Scala, or Rust.

Experience with AI security, governance, and compliance frameworks.

Open-source contributions to data or AI infrastructure projects.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Community Manager to join the SolarBalls and RunMonsterRun team and help keep our community and content operations running smoothly. As the role has grown, we’re looking for someone who can take ownership of some of the more mechanical and time-consuming tasks, while also bringing creativity and fresh ideas to the table.

You’ll work closely with the existing Community Manager on everything from RMR and SolarBalls Shorts localization and leak reporting to brainstorming Quirk-A-Thons, announcements, activities, and promotional content. The goal is to become a trusted partner who can help keep the community active, organized, and engaged.

What You’ll Do

  • Collaborate with the Community Manager to brainstorm and develop titles, announcements, and promotional content for SolarBalls and RMR.
  • Collaborate with the Community Manager to create and maintain a content calendar around important dates, holidays, and relevant community moments, as well as coordinate events and contests.
  • Brainstorm and help develop daily Quirk-A-Thons and other community activities for RMR.
  • Support leak reporting and removal, helping ensure unauthorized content is identified and addressed promptly.
  • Support the execution and coordination of community initiatives and recurring content-related tasks.
  • Monitor and respond to operational community needs, escalating issues when necessary.
  • Provide short-term coverage for the Community Manager to maintain continuity during vacation or other periods of absence.

About You

  • Experience in community management, social media, content operations, or a similar role, ideally within entertainment, gaming, YouTube, or digital media.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage recurring tasks consistently without losing track of deadlines.
  • Comfortable working with content platforms and handling repetitive operational workflows such as uploading, adapting, and organizing content.
  • Creative and proactive, with the ability to contribute ideas for community activities, announcements, titles, and promotional content.
  • Strong written communication skills and the ability to adapt content for different audiences and platforms.
  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating closely with another Community Manager.
  • Able to quickly learn new tools, workflows, and platform-specific processes.

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • Help shape and grow an active entertainment community while working closely with an experienced Community Manager.
  • Have a mix of operational, creative, and community-focused responsibilities rather than a purely administrative role.
  • Contribute directly to content ideas, community activities, and promotional initiatives.

About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

What you will be doing

  • KPIs - Consistently achieve sales targets
  • Outreach - Calling key decision-makers using phone, email & social touches with the goal of bringing on new business (there may be some in-person meetings as appropriate)
  • Selling - Present, promote and sell products and services through product demos to prospective and existing partners
  • Sales Cycle - Managing the entire sales process from prospecting to close
  • Partnering - Perform cost-benefit and needs analysis with existing/potential partners in order to align our solutions to their needs and business objectives
  • Collaboration - Work closely with other departments to ensure a seamless partner experience
  • Market Trends - Provide feedback about ongoing trends in the industry
  • Leads - Contact 100% of qualified inbound leads in a timely manner, and document all call outcomes in the CRM
  • Business Partnering - Serve as a lead point of contact for partners on all commercial activities
  • This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver.

What we are looking for

  • Experience - Minimum 1 years of solid B2B sales with a track record of success
  • Industry - SaaS, online marketplaces, or payment platforms is highly desirable
  • Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder
  • Organised - You can multitask, prioritise and manage time effectively
  • Curiosity - You are naturally curious and have a desire to continually grow and develop

Added bonus

  • Bi-lingual - Fluency in Portuguese & English.
  • Any other another language or Spanish is a bonus!
  • Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry
  • At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

Interview Process

  • Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins)
  • Skills & Experience - Video/In-person interview with Head of Sales (Europe) (45 mins)
  • Presentation - Online Case Study for 60 minutes with Team Lead of Business Development & General Manager of Spain.
    • We aim to finalise the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks.

Inclusive workforce

At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.

Company Summary:

Slang is redefining customer engagement through conversational AI, making every interaction seamless and efficient. Our mission is to transform the restaurant industry by providing the ultimate voice AI solution for consistently outstanding customer experiences. At Slang, we foster a culture of innovation, inclusivity, and growth, ensuring that every "Slangsta" (employee) feels valued and connected to our broader AI driven impact

What Your Experience Will Be:

As an Account Executive at Slang, you will play a pivotal role in driving our business forward. Collaborating closely with the Head of Sales and your manager, you will be integral to our rapid growth phase. You will work within the Sales department, engaging with various internal teams, such as Product and Customer Experience, to ensure a cohesive customer journey. Occasional travel may be required for attending conferences or company offsite meetings. Additionally, you will leverage sales technology to enhance productivity and connectivity with prospects and with your teammates.

Why You Belong Here & How You Will Grow:

At Slang , ou believe that trust is a foundational layer to any relationship starting internally as a slangsta through your touch points with each prospect. We cultivate a culture where every Slangster has a deep sense of pride in their achievements with humility. Our team is collaborative, supportive, and driven by shared goals fostering an abundance mindset in addition to belonging and inclusivity. We offer experiences and benefits designed to foster a sense of community both within and outside the organization. Learner Fervor represents our strongest attribute for growth, as we challenge each employee to take every opportunity to learn especially when it's hard. You will grow not only as a professional but also as an individual. We support and foster opportunities for learning and development, aligning with your career aspirations. From weekly team trainings to 1:1 coaching sessions with your manager or peers, company wide workshops, we will help your journey in finding purpose in your work and achieving your fullest potential.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Hunting and Closing: Proactively prospecting and closing new business opportunities.
  • Value Based Discovery and Demos: Actively listening to expertly uncover business impact, quantify value, and position Slang as uniquely qualified to deliver those outcomes.
  • Growing Key Markets: Expanding both existing and new market segments strategically.
  • Pipeline Management: Managing your sales pipeline to ensure quality multi-threading with key stakeholders, driving urgency of purchase, and navigating the buying process to ensure a predictable and steady flow of closed deals.
  • Leverage AI to innovate and drive process efficiency and achieve business objectives.
  • Collaborative Support: Working closely with the Implementation and Customer Success teams to ensure smooth customer onboarding and expansion of existing accounts you have worked with.
  • Exceeding Targets: Consistently achieving and surpassing monthly sales quotas and weekly top-of-funnel metrics.

What You Will Bring:

  • Experience: 3+ years of sales experience with a proven track record of exceeding targets.
  • Traits and Behaviors: Described by others as a self starter, hunter, closer, curious, resourceful, and resilient. You possess a growth mindset and hustle to achieve your very best.
  • Business Acumen: The ability to speak directly to a prospect’s business problems, understand the industry, and act as a consultant.
  • Grit: You give your very best in everything you do and take ownership of the outcomes. Adversity and challenges don’t deter you from your commitment to driving results.
  • Adaptability: Thrives in a fast-paced and ever-evolving startup environment and excels under pressure.
  • Coachability: Open to feedback, self-motivated, and innovative in your approach.
  • Communication Skills: Strong in both written and verbal communication, a good listener, assertive, persistent, and persuasive, with a high EQ.
  • Preferred Experience: Experience in SaaS or hospitality (Hotels or restaurants) is a plus.

How Work Affects My Life:

At Slang, your role as an Account Executive will not only shape your professional trajectory but also enhance your personal well-being. We offer competitive compensation, including various rewards and benefits, to reflect your value to the company. By joining Slang.ai, you’ll find your work meaningful and aligned with your personal goals, shaping a positive worldview and reinforcing your sense of worth by helping businesses more efficiently serve their customers and alleviate pain for their staff while developing your business and hospitality ai acumen and skills.

raw.description:
Location: Remote (North America)

Type: Independent Contractor
Compensation: Commission-Based, Multi-Year Residual

About NexScale™

NexScale™ is an AI-native software company on a mission to empower multi-location wellness and fitness operators to scale without operational overwhelm.

Our flagship product, Chloe™, is an AI Business Partner for premium wellness and fitness businesses. NexScale Chloe™ proactively manages member retention, automates operations, and surfaces what matters—helping operators move from reactive, founder-dependent work toward scalable, AI-supported systems.

We are not building another generic SaaS platform. We are building agentic AI systems that reason, decide, and execute within real business workflows. We believe premium operators deserve enterprise-grade AI. We believe community builds stronger businesses.

About This Role

This is a founding revenue role. You own the full cycle: you find the opportunity, you run the conversation, you close the deal, and you keep the account for years.

We're looking for someone with deep roots in the premium wellness and fitness world—someone who already knows multi-location owners, club operators, and regional leadership personally, and who has closed real business with them before.

You are not an introducer. You are the commercial owner. You run discovery, you present Chloe™, you handle pricing and negotiation, you sign the deal, and then you stay on as the account's primary relationship for the life of the contract. We support you on product depth, technical questions, and implementation whenever you ask—but the account is yours.

Because the account stays yours, so does the commission. You earn on the close, and you keep earning every year the account renews. Build a book of eight to ten accounts and you've built a durable, compounding income stream that pays you long after the initial signature.

Complete flexibility. No hours, no quotas, no reporting lines. You decide how you work, when you work, and who you talk to.

What You'll Own

Full-cycle sales

  • Source opportunities through your existing relationships and reputation in the premium wellness market
  • Run discovery, qualification, and needs assessment with owners and operating leadership
  • Present and demo Chloe™ (we'll train you deeply, and join calls whenever you want technical backup)
  • Handle pricing, negotiation, and multi-year commercial structuring
  • Close the deal and sign the contract

Long-term account management

  • Serve as the account's primary relationship after signature
  • Coordinate onboarding and integration alongside our implementation team
  • Run periodic business reviews and surface operational wins to the operator
  • Drive renewals and multi-year extensions
  • Identify and close expansion: additional locations, expanded scope, upgraded tiers

Commercial discipline

  • Maintain accurate, current CRM records across every opportunity and account
  • Forecast honestly so we can plan capacity and delivery
  • Give us structured feedback from the market so we build the right things

Who This Role Is For

This role is a strong fit if you:

  • Have closed real commercial deals with multi-location wellness and fitness businesses, premium clubs, or regional operators
  • Know owners, operating partners, and decision-makers personally—not just by title
  • Understand what actually keeps premium operators up at night: retention economics, multi-site consistency, staffing, operational drag, member experience at scale
  • Can carry a conversation from first coffee to signed contract without needing a manager in the room
  • Want to own accounts long-term rather than hand them off
  • Are comfortable trading a base salary for uncapped, compounding upside
  • Are genuinely self-directed—no hand-holding, no pipeline babysitting
  • Believe Chloe™ would meaningfully change your network's businesses

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years selling into or operating within multi-location wellness and fitness businesses, premium clubs, or hospitality-adjacent operators
  • Demonstrated history of closing deals yourself, end-to-end
  • Existing relationships with ownership and decision-makers at premium and multi-location operators
  • Comfort with consultative, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • Disciplined CRM and forecasting habits
  • Clear, direct communication and genuine commercial judgment

Premium Operator Focus

We work across the premium wellness spectrum:

  • Multi-location fitness and wellness chains
  • Premium and luxury health clubs
  • Quiet clubs, social wellness clubs, and members' clubs
  • Recovery, longevity, and performance centers
  • Spa, bathhouse, and integrated wellness destinations
  • Premium boutique groups (yoga, Pilates, reformer, barre, cycling, rowing, HIIT, functional)
  • Regional and national wellness networks

What Success Looks Like

By the end of your first 6 months:

  • 8–12 qualified conversations with multi-location operators or premium clubs
  • 2–3 closed accounts, ideally with multi-year commitments
  • A warm, well-documented pipeline of 8–12 active opportunities
  • Accounts you closed are live, healthy, and referenceable

By month 12:

  • 5–10 closed accounts across premium and multi-location operators
  • A residual base that pays you every year those accounts renew
  • Established as the trusted commercial voice for AI adoption in premium wellness
  • Expansion revenue starting to compound from your existing book

Compensation

This plan is built for someone who closes and keeps. You earn a meaningful percentage of first-year contract value on every account you sign, and you continue earning a residual every year that account renews—for the life of the relationship.

  • Commission on close — a competitive percentage of first-year contract value, with a higher rate on the deal sizes most common in this market
  • Multi-year accelerator — signed two- and three-year commitments pay materially more
  • Annual residual — you keep earning on every account you retain, year after year
  • Expansion commission — new locations, expanded scope, and tier upgrades pay at new-business rates
  • Payment terms — Net 30 from contract signature; residuals paid annually on renewal
  • Independent Contractor (1099) — you manage your own setup, taxes, and benefits
  • Start immediately — no onboarding delay, no waiting period

We'll walk through the full commission schedule and realistic earnings scenarios in our first conversation. It is designed so that a book of eight to ten retained accounts becomes a durable, compounding income stream rather than a series of one-time payouts.

Why NexScale™

  • You own the account, and the economics — Close it, keep it, get paid on it every year. Most roles pay you once and move on. This one compounds.
  • Absolute flexibility — No hours, no quotas, no reporting lines. You run your business your way.
  • Real deal support when you want it — Product depth, technical calls, integration questions, security reviews. Ask and we show up. Don't ask and we stay out of your way.
  • Premium ACV — Multi-location and premium club deals carry real contract value, which means real commission.
  • A product that works — Chloe™ delivers measurable retention and operational improvement. You're not selling a promise.
  • Founder-level partnership — Work directly with the founder & CEO, a three-time founder and former product executive who has built and scaled AI companies before.
  • Ground floor of a category — AI Business Partners for wellness operators is a market being defined right now. You'd be defining it with us.

Final Note

We view this as a genuine two-way commitment. When there's strong fit and sustained results, we prefer to grow together—expanded scope, strategic partnership, or an equity conversation as the relationship deepens.

This is a chance to build something real: a compounding income stream on your own terms, deeper relationships with operators you already care about, and genuine impact in a market you know better than we do.

Before You Apply

Please prepare:

  1. Your resume, including a link to your LinkedIn profile
  2. A short cover letter covering: the multi-location or premium operators you've sold to, a deal you closed end-to-end, and why Chloe™ would matter to your network

We only move forward with candidates who can demonstrate real closing experience and genuine relationships in the premium wellness market.

Founded in 1999, Bluegrass Digital is a software development and digital solutions company based in Cape Town, working with local and international clients. We design, build and support websites, digital platforms, software applications and mobile apps, and provide technology talent and staff augmentation services.

What you will do

  • Research target companies that fit our ideal client profile including South Africa, Europe, US markets based on our ICP.
  • Identify relevant technology, digital, product, engineering, delivery, procurement and business decision-makers.
  • Build and maintain accurate prospect and contact lists. Organised and structured.

  • Qualify prospects at an initial level before arranging discovery meetings for the commercial team.
  • Follow up prospects consistently and nurture longer-term opportunities.
  • Re-engage former clients and dormant prospects where appropriate
  • Record all activity, outcomes and next actions accurately in the CRM.
  • Report on activity, conversations, meetings, attendance and pipeline contribution.

What we are looking for

  • One to three years' experience in outbound B2B sales, telesales, appointment setting, lead generation or business development.
  • Confidence speaking to business decision-makers by telephone.
  • Clear, professional written communication for personalised email and LinkedIn outreach.
  • Strong organisation, persistence and follow-up discipline.

Useful but not essential

What success looks like

raw.description:
Marketing Manager, Specialty Markets

Location: Considering all locations in United States with access to major airports

WHO WE ARE:

Boston Imaging is the US headquarters for sales, marketing, service and distribution of all Samsung digital radiography and ultrasound systems. Our advanced medical technologies are used worldwide in leading healthcare institutions, helping providers enhance patient care, improve patient satisfaction, and increase workflow efficiency. Samsung is committed to being a leader in the field of healthcare imaging.
Samsung is a growing presence in the radiology field and is committed to delivering fast, easy and accurate imaging solutions to healthcare providers. The full range of Samsung imaging solutions includes Ultrasound, Digital Radiography, and mobile Computed Tomography (mCT). Samsung aims to become a global leader in the medical imaging space and is investing heavily in developing innovative, advanced imaging technologies that will improve the quality of people's lives.
Samsung keeps a constant eye on the always-evolving, ever-changing imaging industry. By continually enhancing current product lines and seeking to develop new technologies, Samsung is at the forefront of the imaging frontier.

ROLE DESCRIPTION:

Responsible for the development and implementation of marketing programs for the Specialty Markets to support meeting identified revenue and market share objectives. Responsible for product launch planning and development of value propositions for the assigned portfolio and target markets. Responsible for driving effective commercial strategies to increase the sales and unit performance for the Specialty Markets which would include Point of Care, Veterinary, Urology, and other target markets and subsegments.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned

  • Developing, implementing and executing strategic marketing plans for the products and target markets to achieve revenue and market share objectives by attracting potential customers and retaining existing ones.
  • Understand and continually research the market landscape, competition, customer needs, and opportunities in each target market; and assess new potential markets for opportunity.
  • Drive go-to-market and product launch planing including but not limited to defining product positioning, pricing, naming, promotional strategy, and messaging to ensure offerings will be launched successfully and maximize market impact.
  • Define and continually refine the product positioning and messaging by understanding the market dynamics, customer needs, pain points and how to market our offerings effectively.
  • Develop marketing materials and support sales and clinical training.
  • Monitor and analyze the competitive landscape, identifying strengths/weakness to inform the marketing strategy.
  • Will be expected to be the brand evangelist and key spokesperson for the assigned portfolio requiring extraordinary communication and presentation skills as well as the ability to connect with key opinion leaders.
  • Develop, plan, and execute comprehensive tactical marketing campaigns to reach the target audience.
  • Support sales and business in driving internal and external promotion including sales promos, digital campaigns and social media strategy.
  • Identify key tradeshows and events and lead the strategy and vision for every event.
  • Support the Tradeshow team in planning and execution of key events focused on the target markets and personas.
  • Manage and track the budget for all marketing expenses.
  • Work collaboratively with all business functions including but not limited to Product Management, Regulatory, Corporate Accounts, Executive Leadership.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or science required, 10 years of industry experience, preferably in medical imaging, and MBA preferred.
  • A minimum of 10 years’ healthcare product marketing experience includes involvement in market research, marketing plan design, and implementation with a strategic focus on market share growth.
  • Social media experience with YouTube, Face Book, LinkedIn, X, and other web media outlets.
  • Experience in conducting both market and product segmentation assessments as part of a globally focused healthcare company.
  • Knowledge and understanding of policies and competitive dynamics in healthcare industry.
  • Ability to communicate and work effectively to launch new products and leverage media opportunities to maximize brand and market share growth.
  • Ability to communicate with engineers, technical support personnel, doctors, clinicians, and health care professionals on issues relating to product performance, and the health care industry generally.
  • Strong presentation skills and the ability to perform clinical and product training to all levels of customers.
  • I am willing to travel internationally, overnight, and on weekends.
  • Valid driving license and satisfactory driving record is mandatory, and background and drug testing (pre- and post-employment) is required.
  • Budget, expense, and resource management experience required.
  • Must be a result oriented, team player, people person.
  • Must be self-driven to optimize performance without the need for extensive supervision.
  • Must possess excellent verbal and written communication skills and work effectively in a demanding, fast paced environment.
  • Must have and exhibit excellent presentation skills in small and large groups situations.
  • In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire.

COMPUTER & ANALYTIC SKILLS

  • Must be excellent with technology, able to present using a laptop and able demonstrate proficiency with Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, Publisher, Internet Explorer, and Google Chrome
  • Familiarity with clinical and economic outcome data, reimbursement, and managed care policies and procedures is highly desirable.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Regularly lift and /or move up to 25 pounds, frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds and occasionally lift and/or move more than 100 pounds.
  • Often required to Push/pull weights of over 100 pounds when setting up/dismantling trade shows and/or maneuvering Company equipment into place for display.
  • Frequently required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl and talk or hear.
  • Must be able to sit and/or drive for long periods of time when travelling.
  • Must be able to stand for long periods of time (6-8 hours) for multiple days.
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include Close vision, Distance vision, Peripheral vision, Depth perception and Ability to adjust focus.

COMPETENCIES

  • High attention to detail.
  • Understanding of terminology and ability to share and communicate effectively within the group.
  • Ability to organize and prioritize tasks resulting in consistent productivity.
  • Ability to function within and support a team environment and build strong working relationships.
  • Dependable and punctual.
  • Ability to meet accuracy and productivity goals.
  • Good problem-solving skills, ability to evaluate situations and prioritize factors in decision making.
  • Self-motivated, utilize available resources for self-improvement and development.
  • Flexible: able to follow directives and accomplish tasks outside of normal duties.

About Boston Imaging

Located North of Boston in Danvers, MA, NeuroLogica Corporation, who does business in the Ultrasound and Digital Radiography space as Boston Imaging, is a subsidiary of Samsung Electronics who develops, manufactures and markets innovative medical imaging equipment for healthcare facilities and private practices worldwide. As a fast-moving, entrepreneurial company, Boston Imaging is a rapidly growing presence in the medical imaging field and is committed to delivering fast, easy and accurate imaging solutions to healthcare providers. We welcome you to learn more at: .
We offer a comprehensive benefit package which includes;
- 4 Different Blue Cross/Blue Shield Medical Plans to meet your needs
- Dental coverage through BlueCross/Blue Shield Dental
- Vision coverage by Blue Cross/Blue Shield
- Company paid Short-term and Long-term Disability coverage
- $1 for $1 401k match up to 5% managed by Fidelity
- Other benefit options such as company paid employee life insurance, a wellness program, tuition reimbursement and many more!
Please contact NeuroLogica if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or to perform your job. Examples of reasonable accommodation include making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment." Contact careers@neurologica for any questions or requests.
Boston Imaging welcomes diversity and is an AA/EEO Employer – Minorities/Women/Veterans/Disabled and other protected categories are always encouraged to apply. The company’s AAP can be made available for inspections upon requests.
